title: Document Controller (Saudi National)
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.

For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.

Context

SYSTRA is looking for an experienced and detail‑oriented Document Controller to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing all aspects of document control and project documentation, ensuring proper distribution, tracking and retrieval of project documents throughout all project phases, using Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS) such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).

Missions/Main Duties

  • Manage document control processes from project initiation through to close‑out, ensuring that all project documents are properly received, registered, tracked, updated and archived in accordance with project procedures and client requirements.

  • Scan and electronically distribute documents as PDF digital copies to designated recipients, ensuring accurate indexing and metadata, and upload them to the client Contract Management System and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) as required.

  • Maintain a hard‑copy reference library for all project documentation to ensure quick and easy retrieval of information and alignment between hard‑copy and electronic records.

  • Utilize Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) and other approved EDMS platforms to control and update the status of contract documents, including workflows, revisions, approvals and transmittals.

  • Prepare, register and track documents such as correspondence, reports, payment requisitions, variation orders, site instructions, punch lists and NCRs within ACC or other EDMS, ensuring correct coding and referencing.

  • Track and update the status of submittals, safety reports, RFCs, minutes of meetings, progress photographs, contract issues and drawings, ensuring that current approved versions are clearly identifiable and accessible to all authorized project stakeholders.

  • Produce regular reports on outstanding actions and responses on correspondence, submittals and other controlled documents through ACC and other EDMS, providing timely information to project management and the client.

  • Support project teams in the effective use of EDMS platforms (including ACC) by assisting with user setup, folder structures, permissions, workflows, document numbering and troubleshooting of document control issues.

  • Ensure that document control practices comply with SYSTRA s’ procedures, client requirements, contractual obligations and applicable quality management standards throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Coordinate with internal project teams, external consultants, contractors and client representatives to manage document flows, resolve document discrepancies and maintain data integrity across all systems.

  • Contribute to audits and quality reviews by providing accurate document registers, logs, histories and evidence of approvals, ensuring that records are complete and traceable for all project stages.

Profile/Skills

  • Bachelors, Diploma or specialized training in document management systems or similar software.

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in document control, with at least 4 years using EDMS on large‑scale projects.

  • Proven expert‑level experience in Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), including set‑up and administration of projects, configuration of folders and permissions, management of submittals and RFIs, and control of design and construction documentation.

  • Extensive experience in document control throughout the project lifecycle, from initiation to close‑out, using integrated project services functions.

  • Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, with strong technical writing and communication skills.

  • Proficient computer skills with experience in managing electronic documentation systems and data management applications.

  • Preferably at least 3 years of experience working in the Gulf region.

  • Ability to manage concurrent projects and handle large volumes of documentation in a structured and organized manner.

  • Experience in producing detailed reports and tracking documents to ensure compliance and timely responses to project deadlines.

title: Junior Systems Engineer (MBSE)
description:
Title:

Junior Systems Engineer (MBSE)

Job Summary

KBR is seeking an MBSE Systems Engineer to support a Department of War program utilizing Model-Based Systems Engineering methodologies and digital engineering practices.

This position contributes to the development, maintenance, and analysis of system architecture models across the systems engineering lifecycle, supporting activities from requirements development through design, verification, and validation. Working within a collaborative engineering environment, the engineer will partner with senior systems engineers and technical stakeholders to develop model-based solutions that improve system understanding, traceability, and decision-making. The role supports architecture development, requirements engineering, and technical documentation while leveraging industry-standard MBSE tools and defense architecture frameworks. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to mission-critical defense programs while expanding expertise in SysML modeling, digital engineering, and systems integration.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and update system architecture models using SysML/UML within Cameo Systems Modeler and related modeling environments.

  • Support requirements engineering activities including requirements capture, decomposition, allocation, validation, and end-to-end traceability throughout the systems lifecycle.

  • Develop and refine functional, logical, and physical architecture models to support system analysis, design, and integration activities.

  • Generate model views, diagrams, reports, and technical artifacts that support engineering reviews, design decisions, and program deliverables.

  • Support model configuration management activities and maintain architecture repositories using TeamWork Cloud and established program governance processes.

  • Assist with system verification and validation activities by ensuring traceability between requirements, architecture products, and test artifacts.

  • Support alignment of system models, engineering products, and documentation with applicable Department of War architecture frameworks and program processes.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop technical documentation, design descriptions, status reports, and briefing materials.

  • Contribute to digital engineering initiatives and process improvements supporting model-based development and systems lifecycle execution.

  • Other duties as assigned in support of mission and business requirements.

Basic Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance or eligibility to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

  • 1–5 years of experience supporting Model-Based Systems Engineering and systems lifecycle activities.

  • Experience developing or maintaining SysML and UML models using Cameo Systems Modeler, Cameo Enterprise Architecture, MagicDraw, or comparable modeling tools.

  • Experience producing technical documentation including specifications, architecture descriptions, design documentation, or engineering reports.

  • Experience supporting requirements development, requirements traceability, system architecture development, verification, or validation activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Department of War programs, acquisition programs, or defense system development efforts.

  • Experience applying DoDAF or other architecture framework methodologies.

  • Experience using TeamWork Cloud for collaborative model management and configuration control.

  • Experience with PLM tools, Azure DevOps, Jira, SharePoint, and Microsoft Office applications.

  • Exposure to Digital Engineering strategies, model-based analysis, and systems integration activities.

  • Coursework, training, or certification related to MBSE, SysML, or systems architecture development.

Note: This position is contingent upon contract funding and formal program award. Employment offers extended under this requisition are conditional and subject to confirmation of award.

Ben jij een echte teamspeler met ervaring in luchtvaart- of luchthavenoperaties? Weet jij overzicht te houden in een dynamische omgeving en krijg je energie van het aansturen van processen en samenwerken met verschillende stakeholders? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Doel van de functie

Als Station Operations Coordinator ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het dagelijks monitoren, coördineren en optimaliseren van de operationele activiteiten van TUI op de luchthaven. Je werkt nauw samen met externe dienstverleners, luchthavenautoriteiten en interne stakeholders om te zorgen voor een veilige, efficiënte en klantgerichte operatie. Je bent ook verantwoordelijk voor het behalen van operationele SLA's en KPI's met externe leveranciers. Je meet dit door dagelijks rapportages te controleren.

Hoe maak jij een impact

  • Toezicht houden op de dagelijkse luchthavenoperatie en zorgen voor een veilige, compliant en efficiënte uitvoering van alle operationele processen.
  • Monitoren van de prestaties van externe leveranciers aan de hand van afgesproken SLA's en KPI's.
  • Uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles en rapportages om de operationele prestaties continu te verbeteren.
  • Ondersteunen bij onderzoeken naar operationele incidenten en veiligheidsmeldingen.
  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en deelnemen aan verbeterprojecten binnen Ground Operations.
  • Fungeren als aanspreekpunt voor leveranciers en operationele partners.
  • Onderhouden van professionele relaties met luchthavenautoriteiten, overheidsinstanties en andere relevante stakeholders.
  • Bijdragen aan een uitstekende klantbeleving voor onze passagiers.
  • Actief deelnemen aan operationele overleggen en dagelijkse afstemmingsmomenten.
  • Ondersteunen bij de implementatie van operationele verbeteringen en nieuwe initiatieven.

Wat breng je mee

  • MBO+ of HBO werk- en denkniveau.
  • Ervaring binnen luchtvaart, luchthavenoperaties of ground handling.
  • Ervaring met het werken met externe leveranciers en operationele prestatiemonitoring.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om relaties op te bouwen met diverse stakeholders.
  • Een proactieve en zelfstandige werkhouding.
  • Goede analytische vaardigheden en oog voor detail.
  • Vermogen om operationeel te denken zonder de veiligheids- en compliancevereisten uit het oog te verliezen.
  • Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Beheersing van Nederlands, Papiamentu en/of Spaans is een pré.
  • Ervaring met projecten of procesverbeteringen is een plus.

Jij en TUI

Bij TUI krijg je de kans om deel uit te maken van 's werelds grootste geïntegreerde toerismeorganisatie. Je komt terecht in een internationale en dynamische werkomgeving waar samenwerking, innovatie en ontwikkeling centraal staan.

Werken bij TUI brengt vele voordelen, extra’s en fun met zich mee:

  • Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie;
  • Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling;
  • Gratis reisverzekering;
  • 40% personeelskorting op reizen met TUI producten - in lijn met beleid TUI;
  • IPB-regeling;
  • Pensioen;
  • 23 vakantiedagen;
  • Vakantiegeld en nog andere mooie secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Bij TUI Dutch Caribbean werken ongeveer 150 medewerkers verdeeld over de verschillende eilanden. TUI Dutch Caribbean is onderdeel van TUI Nederland. Op het kantoor te Curaçao zit een Reisbureau, Reisleiding en Musement, Customer Services en Station Management. Dit is tevens het thuisadres voor de Curaçaose crewleden (vliegend personeel op Curaçao gestationeerd).

TUI Nederland is marktleider in de Nederlandse reiswereld. 2.500 Medewerkers verzorgen meer dan 1,5 miljoen vakanties per jaar. Internationaal maakt TUI Nederland deel uit van TUI Travel Group, Europees marktleider. Veel van onze vakantiegangers reizen met de eigen luchtvaartmaatschappij TUI fly.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Fire Suppression

Location: Northwest or Yorkshire - Field based role

Join a team that protects what matters most, partnering with Project Engineers across the UK.

Tyco Fire & Integrated Solutions, part of Johnson Controls, is continuing to grow rapidly — and we’re looking for a skilled Project Engineer to strengthen our high-performing Fire Suppression team. If you’re driven, organised, and ready to lead installation excellence across the region, this is an opportunity to build a career with real impact.

About Us

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.


For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What We Can Offer

  • Competitive salary, company car and bonus

  • Hybrid working – site / office / WFH

  • 25 days paid holiday plus bank holidays and sick pay

  • Comprehensive benefits package including 7% matched pension, life assurance, employee assistance program, employee referral scheme, employee discounts including high street brands, cycle to work scheme, and discount on Johnson Controls security products

  • Extensive product and on-the-job/cross-training opportunities with outstanding resources available

  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment

  • Career development through various career ladders including Customer Service

Due to the nature of this position, we are only able to consider applicants who currently have the unrestricted legal right to live and work in the UK. We are unable to provide sponsorship or assist with visa applications for this role.

What You’ll Do

As a Project Engineer, you’ll provide first-line leadership to a team of subcontractors, ensuring high-quality delivery across fire suppression installation projects. Reporting to the Head of Regional Install UK / Contracts Manager UK, you’ll help drive performance, support strategic growth, and maintain strong customer relationships.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading installation delivery, quality, and Health & Safety standards

  • Managing your own financial work bank and supporting cost optimisation

  • Coordinating subcontractors on site

  • Monitoring defects, scope deviations, and documentation accuracy

  • Planning manpower and equipment to meet project timelines and budgets

  • Conducting regular safety and quality audits

  • Supporting team development through performance assessments and annual appraisals

  • Managing workload to maximise productivity and forecast accuracy

  • Preparing reports and programmes for senior management

  • Liaising with Credit Control to minimise disputes and support timely invoicing

What We’re Looking For

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • Experience working within an installation environment

  • Proven experience supervising or managing engineering teams

  • Strong organisational and communication skills

  • Ability to build, motivate, and develop high-performing teams

  • A full UK driving licence

  • Experience with Mechanical Fire Suppression systems

  • Ideally 3+ years in the Fire/Sprinkler industry

  • Good PC literacy, including Microsoft Office

  • Knowledge of LPCB BS12845 and/or NFPA standards (preferred)

Ready to take the next step?

Join a team dedicated to protecting what matters most and help deliver the future of fire suppression. Your tomorrow starts here.

title: Information System Security Engineer (ISSE)
description:
Title:

Information System Security Engineer (ISSE)

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

Why Join Us?

  • Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.
  • Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.
  • Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise security architecture aligned with NIST RMF, DoD STIGs, CIS benchmarks, and organizational cybersecurity policies
  • Perform security engineering activities across system development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, system design reviews, security testing, and accreditation support
  • Implement vulnerability management processes utilizing Tenable Nessus, ACAS, and Qualys to identify, assess, and remediate system vulnerabilities
  • Integrate cybersecurity requirements into Windows and Linux server environments, cloud infrastructure, virtualization platforms, and containerized applications
  • Support incident response and forensic investigations by analyzing security logs, SIEM alerts, network traffic, and endpoint telemetry using Splunk Enterprise
  • Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, and Python to streamline vulnerability remediation, account auditing, compliance reporting, and security monitoring tasks
  • Collaborate with system administrators, network engineers, ISSOs, and application teams to remediate security findings and implement secure configuration baselines
  • Perform security impact analysis for system changes, software deployments, and infrastructure upgrades to ensure continued compliance and operational security
  • Engineer endpoint protection and hardening solutions utilizing Trellix ePO – On-prem, host-based firewalls, and application whitelisting technologies
  • Evaluate and implement cybersecurity tools and technologies to improve system security posture, continuous monitoring, and threat detection capabilities
  • Produce technical security documentation, architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and executive-level risk assessment reports
  • Experience administrating, configuring, and troubleshooting core modules such as Enterprise Password Vault (EPV), Password Vault Web Access (PVWA), Central Policy Manager (CPM), and Privileged Session Manager (PSM) in CyberArk
  • Monitor, analyze, and detect cyber events and incidents within information systems and networks under general supervision
  • Assist with integrated, dynamic cyber defense, coordinate and maintain security toolsets to support organizations’ continuous monitoring and ongoing authorization programs
  • Establish a framework by which cyber risk can be measured and quantified in the marketplace
  • Determine security requirements by evaluating business strategies and requirements; researching information security standards; conducting system security and vulnerability analyses and risk assessments; studying architecture/platform; identifying integration issues; preparing cost estimates
  • Implement security systems by specifying intrusion detection methodologies and equipment; directing equipment and software installation and calibration; preparing preventive and reactive measures; creating, transmitting, and maintaining keys; providing technical support; completing documentation. Verify security systems by developing and implementing test scripts
  • Maintain security by monitoring and ensuring compliance to standards, policies, and procedures; conducting incident response analyses; developing and conducting training programs
  • Responsible for the design, development, implementation, and integration of a DoD IA architectures, systems, or system components for use within computing, network, and enclave environments
  • Ensure that the architecture and design of development and operational systems are functional and secure
  • This includes designs for program of record systems and special purpose processing nodes with platform IT interconnectivity

Work Environment:

  • Location: On-Site – 540 National Business Parkway, Annapolis Junction, MD
  • Travel Requirements: Minimal
  • Working Hours: Standard

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Requires Top Secret clearance with SCI
  • Must have a DoD 8570.1-M/8140 IAT Level III certification (SecurityX (CASP), GCIH, CISA, CISSP) compliant
  • Strong background in networking (TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs), cloud security (AWS/Azure), Kubernetes, and DevSecOps
  • Deep understanding of NIST SP 800-161, NIST RMF, FedRAMP, Common Criteria, ATO package development, and cybersecurity compliance (STIGs)
  • Hands-on experience managing and deploying Tenable Nessus, CyberArk, Trellix, Splunk Enterprise, VMware vSphere, GitLab, Microsoft Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Ubuntu Linux
  • Experience with scripting and automation with Powershell, Python, Bash and Ansible
  • Proven experience in leading projects and mentoring junior ISSE's
  • Present technical briefings to leadership

Basic Compensation: $108,800 – $163,200 (This range is for Washington, DC only)

The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity.


Additional Compensation:

KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short-term incentives, long-term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Site Supervisor – Teesside (Static Site)

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.


For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced and proactive Site Supervisor with a strong fire alarm engineering background to oversee and support the delivery of fire alarm servicing, gas suppression systems, and mechanical suppression systems at a key static site in Teesside.

This role is ideal for someone who is not only confident leading others but is also technically hands-on, able to carry out maintenance tasks themselves, and committed to maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance, and service delivery.

As the Site Supervisor, you will lead a team of on-site engineers and subcontractors while also completing your own planned and reactive maintenance tasks. You will ensure the effective delivery of all fire detection, gas suppression, and mechanical suppression services across the site.

You will be responsible for planned preventative maintenance, routine servicing, fault-finding, and remedial works on a range of systems, including:

  • Conventional and addressable fire detection systems

  • Networked and graphical fire alarm systems

  • Gas extinguishing systems (e.g., Argonite, CO2, Inergen, Novec)

You will act as the primary on-site point of contact, ensuring smooth operations, strong client relationships, and full compliance with site-specific safety and quality standards.

Leadership & Site Management

title: Cookie Crew
description:
Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery + delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!

At Insomnia Cookies, warm cookies are just the beginning.

As a Cookie Crew Member, you're part baker, part hospitality expert, and part late-night hero. Whether you're welcoming guests into the bakery, pulling a fresh tray of cookies from the oven, or packing the perfect delivery order, you'll help create the experience that keeps our fans coming back night after night.

Our bakeries move fast, especially after the rest of the world has called it a night. Every shift is a team effort, and every warm cookie, friendly interaction, and perfectly packed order matters.

If you enjoy working with great people, thrive in an energetic environment, and love making someone's day just a little sweeter, you'll fit right in.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Every shift is a little different, but you can expect to:

  • Welcome every guest with genuine hospitality and make every interaction memorable.
  • Prepare, bake, and package our warm cookies, brownies, ice cream, and other treats to Insomnia's quality standards.
  • Accurately prepare in-store, pickup, delivery, and online orders.
  • Operate the register and process guest transactions.
  • Keep the bakery clean, stocked, organized, and food-safe throughout every shift.
  • Jump in wherever your team needs you, whether that's restocking supplies, helping a teammate, or keeping the line moving.
  • Resolve guest concerns with empathy and urgency, partnering with your Shift Leader when needed.
  • Deliver the kind of experience that turns first-time guests into lifelong Insomniacs.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Physical Requirements

This position regularly requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
  • Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
  • Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
  • Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
  • Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
  • Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
  • Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
  • Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment

This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.

Schedule Expectations

Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Reasonable Accommodation

If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Additional Information

Employment with Insomnia Cookies is contingent upon successful completion of any background checks, employment verification, and other pre-employment requirements applicable to the position and permitted by law.

Ready to Join the Cookie Crew?

Whether this is your first job or your next step, we're looking for people who bring great energy, take pride in their work, and love making someone's day a little sweeter.

When you join Insomnia Cookies, you'll enjoy:

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Early Wage Access (get paid the next day!)
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Employee discount (free cookies!)
  • Opportunities for growth into Shift Leader and other bakery leadership roles

Many of our leaders started as Cookie Crew Members and Delivery Drivers. If you're looking for more than just a job, you'll find plenty of opportunities to grow with us.

We can’t wait to meet you!

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a member of the IP Protection team, you will build and operate data protection solutions that safeguard Micron's intellectual property throughout its lifecycle. You will partner with team members across all of Micron's business areas to identify and reduce data exposure risks, improve data governance, and enable secure collaboration both inside and outside the company.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the enterprise DLP authority, developing and managing data loss prevention policies spanning devices, electronic messaging, internet activities, cloud applications, and storage platforms.

  • Develop and optimize advanced detection capabilities for source code, hardware designs, algorithms, product roadmaps, and other intellectual property using regex, fingerprints, EDM/IDM, and ML-based classifiers.

  • Continuously tune DLP policies to reduce false positives and negatives while implementing automated remediation and tiered response workflows.

  • Monitor and protect against data ex-filtration across key egress channels, including USB devices, email, SaaS applications, personal webmail, messaging platforms, generative AI tools, and cloud sync services.

  • Develop detections for anomalous access and ex-filtration activities, such as bulk downloads, repository mirroring, and unusual after-hours behavior.

  • Author and maintain information protection standards, DLP governance, runbooks, exception processes, and data points to measure program health and operational efficiency.

  • Lead enterprise-wide data classification, sensitivity labeling, rights management, and conditional access initiatives to safeguard sensitive information internally and externally.

  • Drive large-scale, highly technical information protection programs, bringing to bear auto-labeling, workflow integration, and policy-based controls to strengthen intellectual property protection at scale.

​Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of information security experience with hands-on expertise in Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data classification/labeling, and enterprise-scale policy design across endpoints, email, web, SaaS, and cloud environments.

  • Strong technical foundation in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience, with deep knowledge of networking, operating systems, intellectual property data protection, and enterprise data movement.

  • Experience with AI and automation technologies, including machine learning concepts, Copilot Studio, UiPath, SharePoint, and cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.

  • Proficiency with cloud and security operations technologies, including Azure, AWS, GCP, SIEM/SOAR platforms, and scripting/automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, and Splunk SPL.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to operationalize security controls through custom keywords, dictionaries, automation, and collaboration across multiple functions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Candidates with a master’s degree or equivalent experience in technology or science and relevant professional certifications are preferred.

  • Deep expertise in information security, cloud platforms, automation, and technology powered by artificial intelligence, passionate about safeguarding critical intellectual property and business assets across global enterprises.

title: Product Management Director- FinTech
description:
Overview

RealPage Payments is the purpose-built payments engine within the RealPage platform, powering rent, deposit, and fee payments across a broad range of property types. By tightly integrating with RealPage’s property management solutions, RealPage Payments enables property management companies to streamline rent collection, reduce manual processing and fraud risk, and offer residents flexible, digital-first options to pay how, when, and where they prefer.

RealPage sits at the center of where America lives—the software backbone for thousands of property managers and tens of millions of residents. We’re turning that scale into a resident-first fintech platform that goes far beyond payments. This role will lead that transformation, evolving rent from a monthly transaction into a seamless financial journey that helps residents pay, build credit, access new opportunities, and reach the milestones that matter.

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for 3–5 payment product lines, including both existing offerings and new products from concept through launch and scale.
  • Lead a cross-functional product pod (engineering, design, marketing, operations, and analytics) without direct people-management responsibility, setting priorities, clarifying requirements, and ensuring accountability for outcomes.
  • Define, track, and own key performance indicators (KPIs) for your product lines, including adoption, revenue, margin, client satisfaction, and resident experience.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Client Success, and key property management clients to deeply understand their needs, pain points, and opportunities—and translate these into clear product requirements and a prioritized roadmap.
  • Serve as the day-to-day product owner for your domain, writing user stories, managing backlogs, and making trade-off decisions that balance client value, technical feasibility, risk, and commercial impact.
  • Optimize and enhance existing products through experimentation, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement in areas such as UX, conversion, authorization rates, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead the end-to-end launch of new payment capabilities, including discovery, business case development, requirements, build, testing, rollout, training, and post-launch performance measurement.
  • Collaborate with Pricing and Finance to shape pricing and packaging strategies that align with market dynamics, client value, and P&L goals.
  • Partner with Marketing and GTM teams to develop value propositions, positioning, messaging, and sales enablement materials that drive awareness, adoption, and expansion.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on RealPage Payments and the broader payments ecosystem (card, ACH, offline, alternative payments), staying current on industry trends, regulations, and competitive offerings.
  • Participate in key client discussions and executive briefings as the product voice, supporting sales cycles and strategic account planning.
  • Work closely with Operations, Risk, and Compliance to ensure products are resilient, scalable, compliant, and deliver a reliable experience for property managers and residents.
  • Proactively identify product, process, and experience gaps, and drive cross-functional initiatives to address them

Responsibilities

  • 8+ years of product management experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or related technology businesses, with demonstrable ownership of significant product lines or platforms.
  • Proven track record of managing products end-to-end—from discovery and strategy through delivery, commercialization, and iterative optimization.
  • Experience leading cross-functional pods or squads (engineering, design, marketing, operations) in an agile environment, with strong influence skills and no formal reporting lines.
  • Strong familiarity with payment flows (card, ACH, cash/offline, digital wallets) and payment economics; property management, real estate tech, or proptech experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to define KPIs, measure product performance, and drive prioritization and decision-making.
  • Experience working closely with Sales and clients to inform roadmaps, co-create solutions, and support go-to-market and adoption.
  • Strong business acumen and comfort with P&L levers, pricing, and commercial trade-offs.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear narratives for technical teams, commercial teams, and executive stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with agile product development practices, backlog management, and user story creation.
  • Operates with an owner mindset, taking end-to-end accountability for outcomes and results.
  • Customer-obsessed, energized by spending time with clients and users and turning insights into action.
  • Highly collaborative and influential, able to align diverse stakeholders around a clear product vision and roadmap.
  • Structured and analytical, with a bias for action and experimentation.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Passionate about building great payment experiences that make life easier for property managers and residents.

Qualifications

The Research Psychologist will facilitate ongoing studies; write proposals for directed studies and grant solicitations; and complete data analyses and prepare reports, journal articles, and presentations regarding the study results. You will assist in the management and execution of multiple BHP Lab tasks to ensure the team produces high quality, implementable, and timely deliverables that help to reduce the risks associated with the behavioral health and performance of astronauts.

You will work on a highly collaborative team, interfacing routinely with our NASA customer, laboratories in the Biomedical Research and Environmental Sciences Division, external PI teams, and provide timely deliverables to stakeholders for BHP Lab products such as Human Research Program, Space Medicine Division, Extravehicular Activity and Human Surface Mobility Program (EHP), and Mars Campaign Office.

You will:

  • Work with the NASA BHP Lab Lead to implement research activities related to behavioral health and performance risks
  • Develop grant proposals in response to research calls from NASA or external funding organizations
  • Develop directed research proposals and support directed research in space flight analogs, available flight opportunities, and with medical and mission operations personnel
  • Conduct and coordinate data collection, cleaning, and organization
  • Analyze and interpret research and operational data, consulting with NASA statisticians for complex issues
  • Draft interim and final reports, literature reviews and summaries, and project summaries
  • Provide subject matter expertise for research design, methodologies, technologies, and assessments related to behavioral health and performance
  • Disseminate research findings through presentation to NASA program management, presentations at various national and international meetings and working groups, scientific conferences and publishing in peer-reviewed journals
  • Participate in presenting project updates, interim and final results, as well as program objectives and direction to scientists, engineers and managers
  • Collaborate with a variety of contributors and stakeholders including BHP Operations personnel, flight surgeons, mission managers and a multidisciplinary team of personnel to effectively plan and execute the research plans
  • Monitor multiple research project schedules, deliverables, and discuss status of projects with lab project manager
  • Provide inputs to weekly and monthly status reports for NASA technical monitor review
  • Assist NASA technical monitors with updates to NASA standards, and periodic review and update of human spaceflight risks especially relates to behavioral health and performance
  • Advise and assist in the development of protocols and processes that promote efficient and effective management of the BHP Laboratory projects and personnel.
  • Maintain data quality practices and standards established within the laboratory
  • Liaise with internal and external collaborators to effectively plan, track, and complete collaborative research
  • Assist the BHP Laboratory Lead with other duties as assigned to ensure the efficient operation of the lab, or due to NASA’s program requirements changes

What You Bring:

You bring experience leading research design and execution to help answer applied human spaceflight questions. You use your experience and judgment to develop innovative solutions to problems that will inform NASA’s future spaceflight mission planning and preparation. As a key part of our safety culture, you will comply with KBR’s Safety, Health and Environmental Plan, Quality Plan, and all safety policies and procedures, and complete all assigned training.

Your Qualifications:

REQUIRED:

  • Ph.D. and at least 3 years of experience in one of the following areas of psychology: Neuropsychology, Clinical, I/O Psychology, Space Psychology, Health Psychology, Behavioral Medicine
  • Experience conducting behavioral health and performance research, conducting literature reviews, and collecting and analyzing behavioral health and performance data

DESIRED:

  • Prior experience in managing, coordinating, and directing research projects.
  • Prior experience with NASA, Aerospace, Military, or operational environments

Your Skills:

REQUIRED:

  • Proficient with software tools used by the lab including MS Office, R, and RMarkdown
  • Proven ability to apply research methodology for evaluating proposals and research design
  • Demonstrated technical and scientific writing ability, completing all levels of writing, such as research reports and summaries, briefings, technical reports, and project plans, etc.
  • Possess broad understanding of behavioral health and performance outcomes required for individuals required to function effectively in an isolated, confined environment during long-duration exploration missions (e.g., performance, cognition, mood)
  • Highly ethical and respectful of human research data confidentiality, protections, and intellectual property
  • Demonstrated excellence in effective communication and presentation skills with varied audiences, including various levels of management, internationals, scientists, medical professionals and engineers
  • Demonstrated organizational skills for coordinating complex activities and schedules, and managing tasks per a defined timeline
  • Successful project management experience
  • Ability to be flexible and adapt quickly to changing requirements
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary setting where there is frequently divergent or competing goals for the project implementation and outcome
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret requirements for real-time implementation
  • Demonstrated interpersonal effectiveness and professionalism in working with others in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

DESIRED:

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate proven or developing technologies for measuring and assessing behavioral health outcomes as well as evaluating and applying countermeasures in a spaceflight environment.

What to Expect

This position is expected to be 100% on site and a minimum of 60% in person. Occasional travel may be required.

title: BI Developer
description:

Help Shape the Future of Data at Pet Drugs Online

We're looking for a BI Developer to join our growing team and play a key role in transforming data into meaningful insights that help our business thrive. If you're passionate about Power BI, enjoy solving complex data challenges, and love working closely with stakeholders to deliver impactful reporting solutions, we'd love to hear from you.
The role requires 3 days per week on site in our Keynsham office.

What You'll Be Doing

As our BI Developer, you'll be responsible for building, maintaining, and enhancing our business intelligence capability across the organisation. You'll work with stakeholders from across the business to understand reporting needs, develop robust data solutions, be pivotal in our data warehouse rebuild, and ensure decision-makers have access to accurate, actionable insights.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Designing and developing engaging dashboards and reports using Power BI. * Transforming complex data into clear, meaningful insights that support business performance. * Writing and optimising SQL queries, views, and datasets to underpin reporting solutions. * Building and maintaining reliable data pipelines to support efficient data ingestion and transformation. * Collaborating with data owners and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions. * Troubleshooting issues across the data lifecycle, from source systems and ETL processes through to front-end reporting. * Monitoring and improving report, dataset, and query performance. * Supporting BI governance, documentation, and best practices to ensure a scalable and reliable reporting environment. * Contributing to the ongoing evolution of our data and analytics capabilities.

What We're Looking For

Essential Skills & Experience

* Strong commercial experience with Power BI and Power BI Service, including dataflows, apps, and gateway management. * Proven experience designing and optimising data models within Power BI. * Advanced SQL skills, including complex query writing, optimisation, and working with large datasets. * Solid understanding of data warehousing principles, ETL/ELT processes, dimensional modelling, and data transformation. * Experience working with ETL/ELT tools such as Azure Data Factory, SSIS, or similar technologies. * Experience delivering end-to-end BI solutions, from requirements gathering through to deployment. * Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. * Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to detail.

Nice to Have

* Experience using Python for data analysis, automation, or pipeline support. * Knowledge of SQL Server administration, performance tuning, indexing, and maintenance. * Advanced DAX development and optimisation experience. * Experience enabling self-service BI through training, documentation, or user support. * Experience within e-commerce, retail, veterinary, or consumer-focused businesses.

Why Join Pet Drugs Online?

At Pet Drugs Online, you'll be joining a business that's growing fast, investing in technology, and passionate about delivering exceptional experiences for pets and their owners. You'll have the opportunity to: * Make a genuine impact on business decisions through data. * Work with modern BI and data technologies. * Collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple functions. * Contribute to the development of a data-driven culture. * Grow your skills and career within a supportive and ambitious environment.

Ready to Apply?

If you're excited by the idea of turning data into powerful business insights and want to be part of a company that genuinely cares about its customers, pets, and people, we'd love to hear from you.   1. Broad architecture knowledge across various network, cloud, identity, application, data, and infrastructure security domains.

title: Data Engineer / Backend Developer
description:
We're looking for our 4th team member! Do you thrive creating structure in chaos? Would you like to be a part of shaping the data infrastructure in a growing startup? Does your Python code run like a well oiled machine, handling massive datasets with ease? Then proprty.ai might be just the place for you!

The Product

We're building an exciting product to help property owners maintain buildings in a timely, cost-effective, and sustainable manner. We integrate public and private data sources, statistical models, and AI to deliver a modern consumer grade user experience in our app.

The software we’re building includes tools for condition assessment of individual building parts on a property, gathering public data for a building portfolio overview and creating ML & AI models for predicting remaining lifespan and forecasting maintenance cost.

The product went live in 2024, and is solving real problems for real people, and there's SO many things we can do to make it even better!

About You

We won't pretend there's a perfect checklist, but here's who we imagine joining us:

  • You have a couple of years of professional experience building data pipelines, backend services, or similar setups.
  • You take personal pride in your work. You want your work to matter.
  • You're a startup type more than a corporate type: you prefer short decision paths over steering committees, you'd rather ask "why not?" than wait for a mandate, and you're comfortable when the answer to "who owns this?" is sometimes "you do, as of now".
  • You create structure rather than wait for it. Ambiguity doesn't paralyze you.

About Us

The team consists of three people, two Data Scientists and one Data Engineer, working closely with our app team of five. We’re looking for a Backend Developer/Data Engineer to join us in developing and optimizing our data pipelines, backend services, and integrations. Most of our setup is in Databricks on Azure, using Python and SQL for the tasks.

We're expanding into Norway, the Netherlands, Germany and Switzerland, and we need more hands on creating a globalized and scalable setup for the years to come!

The job

Our team is creating an analytics heavy backend both serving the development and implementation of AI & ML models, and providing foundational data for our app team.

You’ll be the second in proprty.ai in this specific area of expertise and should have at least a couple of years of experience from developing similar setups.

Your Main Responsibilities Will Be

  • To evaluate and improve our tech-stack, database structure, and data flow.
  • Creating structured data using a collection of data from multiple sources.
  • Integrating new data sources in the current data flow.
  • Ensuring that data pipelines run flawlessly.
  • Connect our database and data science setup to both our frontend and external systems.
  • Develop API integrations
  • Help drive tech and AI adoption across the teams in proprty.ai

Most of the tasks above should be familiar to you.

Location

We're located in a beautiful historic open office space right next to Rådhuspladsen. We usually work from home on Wednesdays.

This position requires you to be in the office four days every week.

TL;DR

If you have opinions on creating the best data infrastructure and want to be a part of a growing team of young people on a mission to change the industry

description:
About Williamsburg Learning

At Williamsburg Learning (WL), we aim to prepare promising students for meaningful lives as principled leaders. We partner with schools like Williamsburg Academy, Leadership Academy of Utah, and Williamsburg Academy of Colorado to deliver transformational learning experiences that spark curiosity, growth, and purpose.

We live by our values—Growth, Right Action, and a Culture of Belonging. We believe work should be meaningful and fun. Our team is authentic, connected, and committed to doing the right thing for each other and the students we serve.

To support our people, WL offers 100% paid health premiums for full-time employees (75% for families), a 100% 401(k) match up to 4%, PTO, plus many more perks!

If our mission and culture resonate with you, we would love to have you on our team!

Position Summary:

The WL & WA Registrar Specialist ensures the integrity, accuracy, and strategic oversight of student registration, academic records, and course placement across Williamsburg Academy and partner schools. This role safeguards enrollment processes, supports section balancing and forecasting, coordinates academic eligibility and accommodations, and serves as a key liaison between families, partner schools, mentors, and internal teams. The Registrar Specialist plays both a front-stage role with families and a back-stage systems role that supports scalable growth.

Essential Duties

1) Enrollment & Registration Systems Oversight

  • Oversee all WA and TPP enrollment, registration, course change, and withdrawal workflows.
  • Monitor and maintain section caps, balancing honors/classics and Canvas offerings.
  • Implement and refine waitlist resolution processes after add/drop deadlines.
  • Prevent duplicate enrollments, improper course repeats, and prerequisite violations.
  • Support backup course placements to prevent academic delays for students.

2) Academic Records & Compliance Management

  • Maintain student records, transcripts, enrollment confirmations, and transfer documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with FERPA, records retention requirements, and state partner expectations.
  • Monitor academic eligibility for AP, honors, world language progression, and tier placements.
  • Coordinate 504 and IEP documentation with partner schools and ensure mentors receive accommodation details.
  • Schedule mentor participation in IEP meetings when required.

3) Partner School (TPP) & Cross-Department Coordination

  • Maintain Third-Party Partner (TPP) relationships, renewals, and deactivations.
  • Cascade key academic updates (calendar changes, tuition adjustments, policy updates).
  • Coordinate with Academic Advisors, Finance, IT, Special Programs, and the Headmaster Team to resolve escalated registration or funding issues.
  • Manage enrollment exceptions, overrides, and cross-functional problem transactions.
  • Support WA leadership with back-to-school events and key academic milestones.

4) SIS Administration & Enrollment Tools

  • Serve as the primary SIS user-interface administrator for registration-related permissions and roles.
  • Train internal team members on SIS workflows and registration processes.
  • Maintain and improve dashboards (e.g., WL Grow Dashboard) to support enrollment forecasting and staffing alignment.
  • Utilize AI and automation tools to improve efficiency and data visibility.

5) Enrollment Monitoring, Student Tracking & Strategic Support

  • Identify enrollment trends, A-semester failure patterns, and at-risk student indicators.
  • Monitor problem transactions (funding holds, mapping errors, schedule conflicts).
  • Track WA students and support retention efforts through accurate placement and proactive resolution.
  • Provide Tier 2 registration support to families and redirect academic advising questions appropriately.
  • Support the Academics Department with strategic enrollment planning and capacity management.

Non-Essential Duties

Please note that this job description is not intended to cover or list in full the activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities)

  • Strong attention to detail and systems thinking.
  • Familiarity with student information systems and online learning platforms.
  • Ability to manage multiple data points and adapt quickly during enrollment peaks.
  • Clear communication skills and collaborative approach with internal stakeholders.
  • Previous experience in school operations, registration, or academic support preferred.

Physical and Mental Requirements / Working Conditions

  • Expected working hours: Full-time, flexible schedule with seasonal surges in summer and winter.
  • Fully remote role with digital collaboration tools.
  • Requires focus, adaptability, and consistent follow-through.

Benefits

Benefits are available after meeting eligibility requirements and include Health, 401(k) Retirement, Paid Holidays, and Paid Time Off.

Compensation

  • $50,000 - $60,000 annual salary
  • Full Time

description:
Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) is a private research institution devoted to excellence in research in numerous disciplines and designated to the role of keeping the Autonomous Province of Trento in the mainstream of European and international research. The Foundation’s research activities are structured into twelve research centers, each dedicated to a specific area. Information regarding the research centers, their activities and production is available at FBK Cyber Security Centre (CS) develops digital technology and cyber security to foster collaboration between the various stakeholders through a combination of IT risk management techniques (in order to develop highly innovative security solutions that will mitigate vulnerabilities and reduce the risk of attacks) as well as trust management techniques (to improve the interaction between people and technology). As part of the FBK mission, which aims to achieve results of scientific excellence and to produce an impact on society, the Center's mission is to make these techniques available to the largest number of organizations, including SMEs, which account for a substantial part of the EU economy but lack cybersecurity expertise. To this end, integrating automated cyber risk assessment support with trust management that will have the ability to produce operational suggestions to assist ICT solutions designers, developers and administrators in their daily activities is critical.



Si candidi qui sotto dopo aver letto tutti i dettagli e le informazioni di supporto relative a questa opportunità di lavoro.

The candidate will be working in the SaFEWaRe (Secure Code Lifecycle for Applications and Networking) Unit of FBK Cyber Security Center. SaFEWaRe operates along two primary tracks: research in secure code development and industrial collaborations aimed at software implementation.


On the research side, our goal is to provide tools and practices that secure the code throughout its entire lifecycle and to ensure that code adheres to international regulations and standards (such as NIS2).


On the industrial side, we have a long-term collaboration with Cisco Photonics for the development of solutions for the management of fiber-based transport networks, from control-plane features to centralized (SDN) management functions.


FBK actively seeks diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is also committed to promoting gender equality. To promote the inclusion of disabled staff as per law 68/99, the Foundation is available and interested in evaluating the applications received for technical-scientific domains that do not correspond exactly to this call.


Job Description

The SaFEWaRe Unit is currently seeking a skilled and motivated Java developer to join our team. The chosen candidate will contribute to the development of new system features for our SDN controller, collaborating with prestigious Italian and international partners in a dynamic and innovative environment.


The controller is a back-end server application developed in Java integrating multiple functional components needed for the management of optical transport networks. The team oversees the implementation of new functional modules and the API to integrate them into existing applications.


The candidate is expected to contribute to the design, development, and testing of assigned components, with a key responsibility to deliver high-quality software that meets the provided specifications.


Depending on the candidate’s seniority, responsibilities may include:



  • Analyzing the requirements for the software modules providing the related design solutions considering the functional and project constraints.

  • Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
  • Knowledge of Object-Oriented programming principles
  • Knowledge of at least one IDE (IntelliJ, Eclipse)
  • Ability to write robust and well-documented code
  • Ability to design medium complex software components
  • Good knowledge of the English language, both oral and written (At least B2 Level)
  • Intermediate knowledge of the Italian language, both oral and written (At least B1 Level)
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Good communication, relational skills, and a flexible, self-motivated approach

The following elements will be positively evaluated:



  • 3 years post-master experience
  • Knowledge of Agile Methodology
  • Knowledge of a version-control system (preferably GIT)
  • Knowledge of additional programming languages (e.g. python, C/C++) and scripting languages (e.g. bash)

Current schedule:

No set schedule yet, but ideal availability would include (not all, but some) hours: Mon- Fri / 9a-2p

Drive engagement among residents to increase group class participation and build a 1:1 and partner training client base. Growth is fueled by your relationship-building efforts and reinforced by referrals from FOX's skilled therapy team as patients transition out of rehabilitation.

Collaborate with a therapy team

Work alongside FOX Physical and Occupational Therapists and Speech Language Pathologists at the Senior Living Community. Build trust with clinicians who refer patients to wellness, a direct pipeline that supports your schedule growth.

Educate and connect

Expand your reach

Why Join FOX Rehabilitation?

FOX Rehabilitation is a clinician-operated practice rooted in meaningful relationships, evidence-based care, and a mission to abolish ageism. You’ll be supported by leaders who understand client and senior living community engagement, because they’ve lived it.

description:

Retirement Plans Senior Specialist

We are KBR

When you become part of our KBR team, your opportunities are endless. Through internal collaboration, and with our partners and customers, we’re defining tomorrow’s challenges, then providing the innovative solutions to overcome those challenges, always maintaining our commitment to Zero Harm and our Sustainability Platform.

Our Mission Technology Solutions business partners with governments and defense, intelligence, space, aviation, and critical infrastructure customers to deliver high-end engineering, science, technology, and mission support solutions. From national security and readiness to advanced research, cyber, logistics, and life-cycle sustainment, our teams help customers solve complex challenges in some of the world’s most demanding environments. Whether supporting operations on the ground, at sea, in the air, or in space, our clients trust us to deliver mission-critical capabilities every day.

Working with us means being rewarded for your contributions. In addition to competitive benefits and professional development, our people are empowered to use all their potential, creating meaningful change for themselves and our clients. We attract the best minds in the world because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions.

As the needs of the world change, we’re ready to respond and guide the way forward with strategic, sustainable, and technological advancements grounded in more than a century of practical application and execution.

We Are the People Team

We are strategic partners to the business, shaping the talent, culture, and capabilities that enable sustainable growth and high performance. We operate across global markets, partnering with leaders and teams to design practical, scalable solutions that enhance how work gets done and how people thrive. Through strong business insight, data-driven decision making, and a commitment to continuous improvement, we build talent programs that drive impact at every stage of the organization’s evolution.

About the Role

Reporting to the US Benefits Manager, the Senior Specialist, Retirement Plans supports the administration and delivery of retirement plans, primarily within the U.S., while aligned with broader global benefits frameworks. This role ensures retirement plans are administered accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable regulations while contributing to a positive employee experience.

You will partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, vendors, and other stakeholders to support retirement plans, including defined contribution and defined benefit plans where applicable. You will play a key role in day-to-day operations, issue resolution, and compliance activities, while contributing to process improvements and ongoing program support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer U.S. retirement programs, including defined contribution and defined benefit plans, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with applicable regulations, while coordinating with global benefits practices where appropriate.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors, recordkeepers, and administrators to support plan operations, resolve issues, and ensure high-quality service delivery.
  • Oversee day-to-day plan activities, including enrollments, contributions, distributions, and plan changes.
  • Resolve employee inquiries and issues related to retirement plans, including eligibility, transactions, and vendor coordination.
  • Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and HRIS to ensure accurate data flow, contributions processing, and reconciliation of retirement plan activity.
  • Ensure compliance with ERISA and applicable regulations by overseeing regulatory filings (e.g., Form 5500), maintaining documentation, and ensuring audit readiness.
  • Lead and coordinate annual compliance activities, including plan audits, compliance testing, and contribution reviews, ensuring timely and accurate completion.
  • Assist with retirement plan communications, including employee education materials and support for awareness campaigns.
  • Analyze data and reporting to identify discrepancies, trends, and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
  • Support system updates, data integrity, and integration efforts across HRIS and vendor platforms.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and service delivery.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required.
  • 5+ years of experience in retirement plans, benefits, or a related Total Rewards function.
  • Experience supporting retirement programs in a complex or multinational organization preferred.

Functional Expertise:

  • Working knowledge of retirement plans, including defined contribution (e.g., 401(k)) and defined benefit plans.
  • Understanding of applicable regulations (e.g., ERISA, IRS, and related compliance requirements), with exposure to global retirement programs preferred.
  • Experience working with retirement plan vendors, recordkeepers, or third-party administrators.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage data accurately and handle sensitive information.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder collaboration skills in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience working with HRIS and benefits administration systems (e.g., Workday, SAP) preferred.
  • Proficiency in Excel and general reporting tools to support data analysis and reconciliation activities.

Location:

The ideal candidate will be located in the Houston, TX or greater Washington D.C.-Baltimore area. While KBR strives to maintain a global, flexible, diverse, and sustainable work environment for our people, we currently offer flexible working arrangements, including hybrid, remote working, and virtual delivery to help reinforce and strengthen our strong commitment to becoming a more socially sustainable company, allowing us to provide greater work-life balance and flexibility.

Additional Compensation: KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Benefits: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Who We Are

title: Principal Engineer - Control & Automation Systems
description:
Job Description Summary

The Control Automation System Principal Engineer serves as the technical authority for automation systems, industrial controls, and operational technologies across the organization. This role leads the architecture, design, implementation, and governance of advanced control systems that enable safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing or operational performance. The Principal Engineer mentors engineering teams, drives innovation, establishes automation standards, and leads strategic initiatives aligned with business objectives.

Job Description

The world is electrifying faster than ever, and at GE Vernova, we're building the technologies that make it possible. As a Principal Engineer in Control & Automation Systems, you'll serve as a technical authority shaping the future of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) and digital substation technology. This is a role where your expertise directly influences how power reaches millions of people — and where your ideas help define what comes next.

What You'll Do

You'll lead the technical design, architecture, and delivery of advanced control and automation systems for HVDC and digital substation environments. Specifically, you will:

  • Own the technical solution for control and automation systems end-to-end — from requirements definition and architecture through to implementation, validation, and governance — ensuring designs meet customer requirements and comply with IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5, and related power system communication standards.
  • Lead HVDC control and protection design, including network and cybersecurity architecture, Substation Configuration Language (SCL) data modelling, protection logic, interlocking logic, and integration of Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs), bay controllers, merging units, and Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs) within digital substations.
  • Drive engineering excellence by identifying and implementing improvements to methods, tools, processes, and systems that enhance customer value, and by upholding Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) principles across the team.
  • Collaborate and influence across project teams, New Product Introduction (NPI), utilities, and vendors to support system integration, testing, and commissioning; provide technical consultation to cross-functional teams on manufacturing, supply chain, and field challenges.
  • Shape the profession — represent GE Vernova externally at industry conferences and in professional bodies such as IEC and CIGRE; contribute to the Patent Evaluation Board (PEB); mentor junior engineers; and support hiring, promotion, and succession planning within Engineering & Technology.


Who We're Looking For

You're a seasoned power systems engineer with significant hands-on experience in substation automation and HVDC control systems — someone who combines deep technical authority with the ability to lead, influence, and inspire.


Required

  • A formal education in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, or a related discipline is valued, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements.
  • Significant experience in power system automation or substation control engineering, including substantial experience with IEC 61850-based systems.
  • In-depth knowledge of IEC 61850 protocols and concepts, including Manufacturing Message Specification (MMS), Generic Object-Oriented Substation Events (GOOSE), SCL, and Sampled Values.
  • Strong understanding of communication networks, including Ethernet, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), and Parallel Redundancy Protocol/High-availability Seamless Redundancy (PRP/HSR) redundancy architectures.
  • Proven experience configuring and integrating IEDs, protection relays, substation bay controllers, merging units, and HMI systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Distributed Control System (DCS) platform integration.
  • Working knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 communication protocols, including IPv4, Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP), Demilitarised Zone (DMZ), Virtual Private Network (VPN), Distribution Management System/Advanced Distribution Management System (DMS/ADMS), DNP3, and Modbus.
  • Experience using IEC 61850 System Configurators and IED Connectivity Packages.


Preferred

  • Active participation in IEC, CIGRE, or equivalent industry standards working groups.
  • Experience leading root cause analysis for complex Voltage Source Converter (VSC) control and protection issues.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity design principles for industrial control systems.


Why GE Vernova

At GE Vernova, we're on a mission to electrify and decarbonize the world. That means building technologies that are reliable, sustainable, and transformative. Joining our team means working alongside some of the brightest minds in power engineering, contributing to projects that have a genuine global impact, and growing your career in an environment that values curiosity, collaboration, and technical leadership.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes
