title: Operations Requirements Analyst
description:
Title:

Operations Requirements Analyst

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

Why Join Us?

  • Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.

  • Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

Key Responsibilities:

KBR is seeking a US Space Force (USSF) Operational Requirements Analyst.

The Operational Requirements Analyst will support the USSF Headquarters Staff, office of the Chief of Strategy and Resourcing (CSRO), Directorate of Space Requirements (S5R). The USSF is a military service that organizes, trains, and equips space forces in order to protect U.S. and allied interests in space and to provide space capabilities to the joint force. USSF responsibilities include developing Guardians, acquiring military space systems, maturing the military doctrine for space power, and organizing space forces to present to our Combatant Commands. The Directorate of Requirements is responsible for developing and integrating Joint Space Requirements for the DoD.
The Candidate will:
- Interface and perform duties to support the Service integration with the Joint Capabilities Integration process (JCI).
- Participate in the Joint Requirements Oversight Council (JROC) process, to include attending Functional and Joint Capabilities Boards (FCB/JCB) as the USSF representative.
- Review, staff and assess capability development products such as Combatant Command Derived Requirements (CRDs), Mission Area Requirements Documents (MARDs), Rapid Prototyping Requirements Documents (RPRD), and System Requirements Documents (SRD)
- Advise senior leadership in planning, developing, and coordinating capabilities development process actions with the CSRO
- Synthesize data analytics to assess and provide feedback on the capability development artifacts for each program within your requirements branch
- Aid in creation of digital requirements models

Work Environment:

  • Location: On-site, Pentagon, Applicant should be available to work as early as 7:30 AM standard

  • Travel Requirements: Minimal 0-20% to NCR region

  • Working Hours: Standard

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Demonstrated understanding of Space enterprise to include DoD requirements, acquisition, and budgeting processes and applicable Defense Space guidance and policy.

  • Demonstrated ability to plan, organize, lead and execute requirements projects and out-brief results to senior leadership.

  • Knowledge of the DoD Requirements and Capability Development processes --Joint Capabilities Integration (JCI) and the Joint Requirements Oversight Council (JROC).

  • Experience supporting Service HQ or DoD Agency or IC staffs.

  • Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent, plus 10+ yrs. applicable experience in Service, COCOM, and/or Joint Staff

  • Must have an active TS/SCI clearance

Desired:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace or STEM field. Degree in Operational Research a major plus

  • 12+ years experience in an operations, engineering, scientific, analysis, policy or planning field related to Defense Space

  • HQ AF/SAF staff experience within the past 3 years

  • Experience editing Joint Requirements documentation

  • Experience with space system Acquisitions, the Space Force and Pentagon

  • Experience with staffing tools such as: Task Management Tool (TMT), Knowledge Management/Decision Support (KM/DS)

  • Experience with Model-Based System Engineering (MBSE) and Digital Process Improvement.

  • Excellent communications and interpersonal skills

  • Applicant should be well versed in Microsoft Office software, Adobe Acrobat, and Sharepoint

  • Familiar with AI utilization for reports, forms, and other administrative documentation.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40hrs

Basic Compensation:

The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity.

For Virginia, the compensation will be $160,000K-$180,000K.

Additional Compensation:

KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Ready to Make a Difference?

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
På vegne af Frameo søger vi en Senior Data Engineer, der vil være med til at sætte den tekniske retning for en moderne dataplatform og omsætte forretningsmæssige behov til skalerbare dataløsninger. Du får en central rolle med stor indflydelse på arkitektur, teknologivalg og udviklingen af en international softwarevirksomhed, hvor data er en afgørende del af forretningen.

Du bliver en central drivkraft i Frameos dataområde og får ansvaret for at gøre data til mere end rapportering. Du omsætter datastrategien til løsninger, sætter standarderne for kvalitet og arkitektur og skaber det fundament, som gør organisationen endnu skarpere i sine beslutninger.

Dine primære ansvarsområder omfatter blandt andet at:

  • Udvikle og videreudvikle dataplatformen med fokus på skalerbarhed, kvalitet og robuste løsninger
  • Bidrage til den overordnede datastrategi og omsætte forretningsbehov til tekniske løsninger
  • Definere standarder for datakvalitet, dokumentation og moderne dataarkitektur
  • Planlægge og prioritere datainitiativer samt tage ejerskab for det tekniske roadmap
  • Fungere som teknisk sparringspartner for udviklings-teams, Product Management og øvrige forretningsområder
  • Designe, udvikle og vedligeholde data pipelines og aggregater
  • Udvikle dashboards og datavisualiseringer, der understøtter datadrevne beslutninger
  • Højne kvaliteten af vores aggregater og hvordan de tilgår, så det de bliver mere tilgængelige for medarbejdere
  • Sikre høj dataintegritet og veldokumenterede løsninger gennem struktureret udvikling og versionsstyring

Med direkte reference til Head of Tech, Jette Collie, bliver du en del af Frameos Tech-team på 21 medarbejdere med kompetencer inden for app-udvikling, backend, QA, infrastruktur og platform.

Platformen i hænderne med strategien i blikket

Du har en relevant it-uddannelse og minimum fem års erfaring som Data Engineer eller fra en tilsvarende rolle, hvor du har arbejdet med både udvikling og videreudvikling af dataplatforme. Du har stærke SQL-kompetencer og solid erfaring med store, komplekse datasæt, ELT-/ETL-orkestrering samt cloud-baserede data warehouse-løsninger som BigQuery eller tilsvarende. Derudover har du erfaring med visualiseringsværktøjer som Looker Studio, Power BI eller lignende, samt dbt til datatransformation og modellering.

Erfaring med Airflow, Git og Python er en fordel. Endelig arbejder du aktivt med AI-værktøjer i dit daglige dataarbejde, eksempelvis til kodegenerering, fejlsøgning, dokumentation eller optimering. Samtidig motiveres du af en rolle, hvor du bidrager til tekniske beslutninger om dataplatformens arkitektur, teknologivalg og langsigtede udvikling. Du behersker dansk og engelsk på et højt niveau.

Ser næste skridt og tager det

Det falder dig naturligt at tage ansvar og identificere de opgaver, der skaber størst værdi. Du motiveres af at kombinere strategiske overvejelser med hands-on udvikling og trives med selv at bygge de løsninger, du er med til at definere. Samtidig kommunikerer du komplekse tekniske problemstillinger i øjenhøjde med både tekniske og andre stakeholders og bidrager til et stærkt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen. Derudover trives du i et ambitiøst og uformelt vækstmiljø med høje standarder, korte beslutningsveje og stor indflydelse.

Frameo er en internationalt orienteret tech-virksomhed, som har skabt verdens førende platform til deling af billeder og videoer på digitale fotorammer. Frameo samarbejder med mere end 100 fabrikker i Kina og anvendes i over 130 lande. Virksomheden oplever markant vækst, har mere end 20 millioner app-downloads og en af markedets højeste brugerratings. Frameo kombinerer entreprenant energi med en stærk teknologisk løsning og står foran en vækstfase, hvor organisationen skal udvikles fra scale-up til en mere etableret og professionelt drevet virksomhed.

description:
Enable Impact at the Heart of Technology Development at BCD!

AI Business Transformation Lead (Remote)

Full time, United Kingdom, Netherlands, Spain

If the Head of AI defines the strategy, this role brings that strategy to life within BCD.

As AI Business Transformation Lead, you will sit at the intersection of business innovation, AI adoption and organizational change. You will identify high-impact opportunities, launch new AI-powered capabilities, and help redesign how work gets done across the enterprise.

This role is ideal for a operationally minded innovator who understands AI's potential and enjoys turning ideas into measurable business outcomes.

The Opportunity

AI is only valuable when it changes how people work.

Your role will be to:

  • Identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases across business functions (e.g., client services and support, program management, sales and response drafting, spend-report analysis, sales proposal generation, HR/finance process automation)
  • Drive AI-driven innovation through a discover, design, develop and deploy model: surface new use cases and business opportunities that go beyond incremental process improvement
  • Lead and develop the embedded AI champion network across business units, setting priorities and coaching change management
  • Partner with the CoE's Solutions Engineers to scope and pilot new AI-supported workflows, using shared platform tools rather than one-off builds
  • Own change management across functions: train colleagues, update SOPs, and track adoption of new AI-assisted workflows
  • Engage with enterprise vendors – including ERP, HR, CRM and other SaaS providers to effectively deploy AI capabilities
  • Monitor and report productivity and innovation impact (time saved, error reduction, new revenue or business opportunities) to the AI Leadership Council and the CoE
  • Act as the voice of the business into the CoE roadmap — ensuring the central platform addresses real operational and commercial needs
  • Chair the cross-functional AI champion community of practice (shared training, standards updates, lessons learned)

You will help ensure AI becomes a daily reality for employees, not just a technology initiative.

A Truly Global and Flexible Role

Working across regions, functions and markets, you will collaborate with leaders from operations, sales, finance, people teams, product and technology.

The role is global in scope and fully remote, providing the opportunity to influence business transformation at scale

A Strategic Success Role

Success means:

  • Launching new AI opportunities and initiatives
  • Increasing adoption of AI-enabled workflows
  • Delivering measurable productivity gains
  • Building a thriving community of AI champions
  • Accelerating innovation throughout the organization
  • Connecting business needs with emerging AI capabilities
  • Number of new AI-driven use cases or business opportunities identified and launched
  • Number of workflows across functions actively using AI tools (vs. pilot-only)
  • Measurable productivity or quality improvement across core business processes
  • Adoption/training completion rate across embedded champions and function staff
  • Speed of escalation and resolution of AI-related risks flagged from the field

Who You Are

You likely bring:

  • 3+ years driving AI-led transformation within a large-scale organization
  • Founder or early-stage startup experience required — comfort building new capability from zero, in ambiguity, with limited resources
  • Demonstrated success adopting new tools/technology and driving change management across teams
  • Excellent fluency in AI/LLM concepts (prompting, limitations, appropriate use); deep technical background not required
  • Strong communication skills; able to translate between commercial/operational needs and technical capability
  • Prior experience piloting or scaling new systems/process change across multiple functions is a strong plus

You are curious, entrepreneurial and energized by building something new

What We Offer

  • A highly visible role at the centre of enterprise transformation
  • Opportunity to shape the future of work
  • Global stakeholder exposure
  • Collaboration with AI experts and executive leaders
  • Remote-first flexibility
  • A chance to influence innovation across an entire company
  • A culture that values innovation, ownership and experimentation

Why This Role Is Different

Most transformation roles focus on process improvement.

This one focuses on reimagining work itself.

You will help create AI-first ways of working and identify entirely new opportunities that can redefine how a global company operates and competes

title: Sr Director, Supply Chain Transformation
description:
Current CVG employees, please click HERE to login and apply.

​Position Summary

Seeking a results-oriented Sr Director of Supply Chain Transformation to lead strategic initiatives that improve end-to-end supply chain performance, inventory optimization, procurement effectiveness, and operational excellence across the organization. This role will drive the design, implementation, and sustainment of supply chain transformation initiatives, including advanced planning tools, digital supply chain capabilities, data transparency, process standardization, and organizational change management.
The Sr Director of Supply Chain Transformation will serve as a key change agent, partnering with Operations, Materials, Procurement, Engineering, IT, Finance, and suppliers to deliver measurable improvements in service, cost, inventory, and productivity. The successful candidate will combine strong leadership, supply chain expertise, and transformation experience to build scalable processes and capabilities that support CVG's long-term growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Supply Chain Transformation Leadership

  • Develop and execute a multi-year supply chain transformation roadmap aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives focused on inventory optimization, supplier collaboration, forecasting, planning, and materials management.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational performance through process redesign, technology implementation, and organizational capability development.
  • Establish transformation governance, project plans, milestones, and performance tracking mechanisms.
  • Drive adoption of best practices across sourcing, planning, procurement, logistics, and materials management functions.

Digital Supply Chain and LeanDNA Leadership

  • Lead implementation and continuous improvement of LeanDNA and other supply chain planning technologies.
  • Establish supplier onboarding frameworks and engagement strategies to maximize platform utilization.
  • Improve visibility, traceability, and actionable insights throughout the supply chain.
  • Partner with IT and business stakeholders to ensure successful integration of digital tools and data sources.
  • Drive user adoption and realization of expected business benefits.

Inventory and Materials Management

  • Improve inventory accuracy, inventory turns, service levels, and working capital performance.
  • Develop sustainable processes for inventory management, shortage mitigation, and demand-driven planning.
  • Support improved forecast integration and supply planning capabilities.
  • Establish metrics and accountability structures that drive materials' performance.

Procurement Process Excellence

  • Lead development and standardization of procurement policies, procedures, and governance practices.
  • Drive alignment between procurement, planning, and manufacturing operations.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities that reduce complexity and improve efficiency.
  • Develop performance metrics and dashboards to enhance decision-making and accountability.

Change Management and Organizational Development

  • Develop and execute change management strategies supporting transformation initiatives.
  • Design and deliver training programs to support new processes, systems, and capabilities.
  • Establish employee certification and competency development programs.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Coach and mentor supply chain leaders and functional teams throughout transformation efforts.

Performance Management

  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across inventory, service, supplier performance, procurement, and operational execution.
  • Develop executive-level reporting and transformation scorecards.
  • Present progress, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure projects deliver measurable operational and financial improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive supply chain, operations, procurement, or transformation leadership experience.
  • Minimum 5 years leading large-scale business transformation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing supply chain planning, inventory optimization, or digital supply chain solutions.\
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Experience with ERP systems and advanced planning technologies.
  • Proven track record of driving measurable improvements in inventory, service levels, cost, and operational performance.

description:
Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery + delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. Insomnia Cookies is one of the fastest growing, late-night, sweet indulgence companies in the country, and at the present time, we are actively interviewing Cookie Crew for our brand new Upper Dublin, PA location! This brand new bakery will be located at 1115 Market St, Dresher, PA 19025! As a member of the Cookie Crew, you are the ultimate Insomniac. Not only are you the point person at the front of the store for interacting with our customers, but you also get to bake all of our awesome Warm and Delicious cookies as well! Check out some of our content vids below to learn more: Who We Are! Insomnia Cookies Timeline Core Values SOME OF OUR SWEET COOKIE CREW PERKS: · Pay Rate: $15.00/hr - Flexible part-time work schedules · Pay-on-Demand (no longer do you have to wait until the end of the week. Get paid daily for your total shift earnings from the day before!) · Paid vacation and sick time off · Pet insurance for your furry loved ones · Interactive training & mentorship · Job stability with a rapidly growing and reputable company · Achievable growth/promotion opportunities · You get to work in a fun, exciting team environment · Employee discount and FREE COOKIES with every shift! WHAT ELSE WILL I DO AS A MEMBER OF THE COOKIE CREW? · Promptly greet guests entering the store and take their orders according to procedure · Help customers understand menu items, answer clarifying questions, and repeat orders for accuracy · Give each customer a warm experience with a smile in person & over the phone · Bake our delicious cookies to perfection & a scoop of ice cream · Ensure fast, warm, and correct delivery orders are packaged and sent out · Handle cash and payments accurately and have no shortages or overages · Cleaning, sanitizing, and maintaining the bakery DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE: · At least 6 months of experience in a customer service focused role - preferred · Personable, genuine, outgoing demeanor · Customer service focused and a willingness to exceed guest expectations · Great communication, organizational and math skills · Must be able to lift up to 40 lb boxes of product · Must be 18 years or older to be employed · Must be able to work nights, weekends and holidays · Legally eligible to work in the United States

At Insomnia Cookies, warm cookies are just the beginning.

As a Cookie Crew Member, you're part baker, part hospitality expert, and part late-night hero. Whether you're welcoming guests into the bakery, pulling a fresh tray of cookies from the oven, or packing the perfect delivery order, you'll help create the experience that keeps our fans coming back night after night.

Our bakeries move fast, especially after the rest of the world has called it a night. Every shift is a team effort, and every warm cookie, friendly interaction, and perfectly packed order matters.

If you enjoy working with great people, thrive in an energetic environment, and love making someone's day just a little sweeter, you'll fit right in.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Every shift is a little different, but you can expect to:

  • Welcome every guest with genuine hospitality and make every interaction memorable.
  • Prepare, bake, and package our warm cookies, brownies, ice cream, and other treats to Insomnia's quality standards.
  • Accurately prepare in-store, pickup, delivery, and online orders.
  • Operate the register and process guest transactions.
  • Keep the bakery clean, stocked, organized, and food-safe throughout every shift.
  • Jump in wherever your team needs you, whether that's restocking supplies, helping a teammate, or keeping the line moving.
  • Resolve guest concerns with empathy and urgency, partnering with your Shift Leader when needed.
  • Deliver the kind of experience that turns first-time guests into lifelong Insomniacs.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Physical Requirements

This position regularly requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
  • Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
  • Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
  • Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
  • Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
  • Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
  • Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
  • Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment

This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.

Schedule Expectations

Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Reasonable Accommodation

If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Additional Information

Employment with Insomnia Cookies is contingent upon successful completion of any background checks, employment verification, and other pre-employment requirements applicable to the position and permitted by law.

Ready to Join the Cookie Crew?

Whether this is your first job or your next step, we're looking for people who bring great energy, take pride in their work, and love making someone's day a little sweeter.

When you join Insomnia Cookies, you'll enjoy:

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Early Wage Access (get paid the next day!)
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Employee discount (free cookies!)
  • Opportunities for growth into Shift Leader and other bakery leadership roles

Many of our leaders started as Cookie Crew Members and Delivery Drivers. If you're looking for more than just a job, you'll find plenty of opportunities to grow with us.

We can’t wait to meet you!

Role Overview:

The Client Informatics organization is committed to providing employer clients with reporting, analytics, and consultation that are relevant and actionable. A key enabler of this mission is the Client Consulting and Analytics team. This client-facing team provides expert consultation to New York Life Group Benefit Solutions’ (GBS) largest clients through best-in-class reporting and analytics that demonstrate the value of GBS products and services and support strategic decision-making.

As an Informatics Consultant (IC), you will be responsible for providing analytical support to Group Benefit Solutions’ largest clients. The Informatics Consultant plays an integral role in the client relationship by partnering with Account Management to deliver client reporting, analytics, and consultative messaging. In addition to directly supporting the account management process, this role is instrumental in designing and developing new reporting content and consultative approaches.

What You’ll Do:

Provide consultative support for assigned book of business:

  • Develop consultative analytic reports for Group Benefit Solutions (GBS) National and Regional Account clients, with a primary focus on disability, absence, voluntary benefits, and life products.
  • Use claims data analysis methodology to identify actionable trends for clients.
  • Develop standard and customized recommendations to help clients increase productivity and decrease incidence, absenteeism, and costs. Recommendations should align with the products and services targeted in GBS’ value proposition across all lines of business.
  • Troubleshoot data-related issues or inconsistencies.
  • Develop and cultivate partnerships with Account Management, Underwriting, Operations, and other business partners, centered on individual clients and focused on strategically advising clients on opportunities to reduce health, absence, and productivity risk.
  • Lead presentations of data and recommendations for clients requesting Tier 1 services.
  • Work with Account Management to prioritize and schedule client reports and meetings in alignment with capacity and timing guidelines.
  • Provide reporting within current processes and capabilities across multiple products.

Lead the development of new reporting and analytics capabilities:

  • Collaborate with Account Management, Underwriting, Product, and Claims stakeholders to develop analytics concepts that identify key trends and opportunities and resonate with clients.
  • Identify key strengths and weaknesses in the current reporting model based on interactions with clients, brokers, Underwriting, and Account Management across the GBS book of business.
  • Create reporting capabilities and concepts that demonstrate GBS’ value proposition and enable GBS to achieve a market-leading position in wellness, absence management, and productivity.
  • Partner with key stakeholders to identify marketplace trends and update the analytics strategy.

Partner with key stakeholders:

  • Provide high-level data to identify candidates for case studies and examine client performance at a summary level.
  • Support key analytics and research projects led by Group Benefit Solutions Informatics and the consultative reporting team.
  • Support the development of more effective reporting and diagnostics for integrated reporting.
  • Support operational improvement initiatives based on trends identified through data analysis.
  • Provide training and expert advice to key business partners by sharing tools and techniques related to consultative analysis.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; preferred fields include mathematics, economics, computer science, data analytics, engineering, or related disciplines. Advanced degree or designation preferred.
  • Strong technical skills with data visualization tools (Tableau and Power BI) are required; experience in Microsoft SQL, SAS, Redshift, is required. Statistical programming experience in Python or R preferred.
  • 5+ years of demonstrated business results in an analytics and consulting capacity, with the ability to translate business questions into analytical plans.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Strong presentation and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

The Data Scientist supports advanced analytics and data-driven decision-making for Space and Counterspace intelligence missions. This role focuses on developing models, algorithms, and analytical tools to extract insights from large, complex, and multi-source datasets related to space domain awareness and adversary capabilities. The position involves working with both structured and unstructured data to identify patterns, anomalies, and emerging threats. title: AI and IT Lead
description:
Arkeus builds AI-powered sensing systems that help autonomous platforms see, understand and act in the most complex and contested environments. Our technology is deployed across defence and national security applications — already protecting lives and strengthening security across the U.S. and allied markets.

Backed by QIC, Main Sequence, R+VC, Salus Ventures, Folklore Ventures, DYNE Ventures and Beaten Zone Venture Partners, Arkeus is entering a major growth phase. We are a small, fast-moving company with the energy and ambition of a start-up and the technical credibility of a world-class defence technology provider.

We work at the intersection of optics, autonomy, robotics and real-time AI — and we deploy what we build. If you want to ship technology that matters, not a company that ships PowerPoint decks, this is where you belong.

About the role

As AI and IT Transformation Lead, you will define and drive how Arkeus uses AI and IT to operate at maximum efficiency. You will own our AI transformation plan end-to-end, bring core IT services in house, stand up IT for our growing US operations, and ensure our cybersecurity posture is compliant with the Defence Industry Security Program (DISP) in Australia and NIST in the US.

This is a senior, hands-on role with real autonomy — you'll set the direction for how Arkeus uses AI and technology, then build the systems, team and vendor relationships to make it real. You'll work across every function to find where AI and automation can remove manual effort, and you'll be the one who actually ships it, not just recommends it. Attitude matters as much as experience: we're looking for someone who is genuinely excited by new technology and ready to change the way things are done.

About you

You get genuinely excited about new technology and are always looking for a smarter way to do things. You don't wait for permission to try something new, and you're comfortable being the person who champions change even when it's unfamiliar to others.

You combine strategic thinking on AI and IT strategy with the hands-on ability to actually implement it — you can define a transformation roadmap and also roll up your sleeves to stand up systems, negotiate with vendors, and bring IT services in house.

You have experience building or transforming IT functions, ideally including standing up operations in a new country, and you understand the compliance rigour required in regulated industries such as defence. Importantly, you treat cybersecurity as a first-class part of the job, not an afterthought.

Key responsibilities
  • AI Transformation Plan: Define and implement Arkeus's AI transformation plan, identifying where AI and automation can drive maximum efficiency across the business — from engineering to operations to back-office.
  • IT Insourcing: Bring our IT services in house, building the internal capability, systems and processes to replace outsourced or ad hoc IT support.
  • US IT Setup: Design and stand up IT infrastructure and support for our growing US presence, matching the standards and reliability of our Australian operations.
  • Cybersecurity Compliance: Ensure Arkeus's cybersecurity posture is compliant with the Defence Industry Security Program (DISP) in Australia and NIST standards in the US.
  • Technology Change Leadership: Champion a culture of adopting new technology across Arkeus, bringing teams along with change rather than mandating it from above.
  • Vendor & Systems Management: Own the selection, implementation and ongoing management of core IT and AI tools and platforms used across the business.
What success looks like

In your first 90 days:

  • You have mapped Arkeus's current AI and IT landscape — tools, vendors, gaps and risks — and shared a clear view with leadership.
  • You have a draft AI transformation plan with clear priorities for maximum efficiency gains.
  • You have assessed what it will take to bring IT services in house and to stand up US IT, with a rough plan and timeline.
  • You have reviewed our current cybersecurity posture against DISP and NIST requirements and identified the gaps.

In your first year:

  • Arkeus has an AI transformation plan in motion, with visible efficiency gains across multiple functions.
  • IT services are run in house, with a reliable, well-supported IT setup in the US.
  • Arkeus is compliant with DISP (Australia) and NIST (US) cybersecurity requirements.
  • You are recognised as the driving force behind how Arkeus adopts and uses technology.
Your experience and skills
  • AI & Technology Leadership: Experience defining and delivering AI or digital transformation initiatives, ideally in a fast-growing or complex organisation.
  • IT Operations: Experience building, running or transforming an IT function, including insourcing services and/or standing up IT in a new country or region.
  • Cybersecurity & Compliance: Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, ideally DISP (Australia) and/or NIST (US), or a strong ability to get up to speed quickly.
  • Change Leadership: A track record of bringing people along through technology change, in organisations where not everyone starts out as an early adopter.
  • Right Attitude: Genuine enthusiasm for new technology, comfort with ambiguity, and a bias towards action over perfect planning.
  • Stakeholder Fluency: Ability to communicate clearly across engineers, operations teams and leadership.
  • You will define how a deep-tech company at the frontier of AI, optics and autonomy runs on AI and technology internally — not just builds it for customers.
  • You will collaborate with exceptional leaders who have decades of combined experience in AI, optics and defence. You will be learning from — and contributing to — the best in the field.
  • You will become part of a close-knit, ego-free team where ideas compete on merit, not seniority. Low politics, high trust. The kind of team you will still be talking about in ten years.
  • You will work hard and be expected to bring your best — and in return you will grow faster than you ever would at a large organisation.
  • You will work on technology that is already deployed in real environments — protecting lives and strengthening security across defence and national security applications.
  • You will receive a competitive, market-benchmarked salary, structured career pathways built to grow with you, and the opportunity to participate in our Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP).
  • You will have the opportunity to mentor bright emerging talent through our highly sought-after intern program and strong connections with leading universities.

title: Senior / Intermediate Full Stack Engineer (Backend-Leaning)
description:
MONKEY builds enterprise-grade catering software for restaurant organizations that operate at scale. We’re looking for a backend-leaning Full Stack Engineer who enjoys solving meaningful product problems, designing thoughtful systems, and shipping high-quality software that customers rely on every day.

This role is a strong fit for someone whose center of gravity is backend design, API design, and system evolution. You’ll help modernize and grow a cloud-based SaaS platform used in real operational environments, with the chance to shape both new features and the way existing systems are improved over time.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and refine full stack features for a multi-tenant SaaS platform serving enterprise restaurant and catering customers.

  • Work across Java/Spring services and modern React/Node.js applications as part of an evolving platform.
  • Contribute to architectural improvements and help move existing patterns toward more event-driven designs over time.
  • Write automated tests and help maintain a reliable, secure, production-ready engineering environment.
  • Author and maintain CI/CD workflows in GitHub Actions and participate in the full lifecycle from design through deployment.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers to turn real-world customer needs into thoughtful software solutions.
  • Take ownership of the features you build, with a strong focus on follow-through, product quality, and steady delivery.

What we’re looking for

  • Professional experience as a full stack engineer, with strong backend depth and comfort working across the stack.
  • Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate in production systems.
  • Production experience with React and Node.js.
  • Experience designing and implementing REST APIs in real-world applications.
  • Experience working with cloud-based SaaS applications and multi-tenant product considerations.
  • Familiarity with message-based or event-driven systems.
  • Experience shipping meaningful software in e-commerce, ERP, or CRM environments; e-commerce experience is especially relevant for this role.
  • Commitment to automated testing, code quality, and secure development practices, including awareness of common web security risks.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, including hands-on work with GitHub Actions or similar tooling.

Nice to have

  • Experience with approval workflows, complex pricing, or enterprise order flows.
  • Exposure to POS integrations or payment gateways.
  • Experience with Azure Cosmos DB or other document databases.
  • Familiarity with observability practices and OTEL-style instrumentation.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code tools, or interest in learning within an established cloud environment.
  • Experience in hospitality, restaurant, or catering software.

Why MONKEY

This is a role where your work can have direct, visible impact on a product used in real business operations. You’ll join a team that values thoughtful engineering, practical problem solving, and steady improvement over unnecessary complexity.

description:

JOB DESCRIPTION
The New York City Office of Chief Medical Examiner (OCME) seeks a Graduate Medical Education Program Specialist to support the administration, accreditation and coordination of the agency’s graduate medical education fellowship programs, including its ACGME accredited Forensic Pathology and Selective Pathology fellowship programs in Forensic Neuropathology and Cardiovascular Pathology. This is a per-diem position with an anticipated average commitment of approximately 20 hours per week.

OCME’s fellowship programs provide advanced subspecialty training to physicians pursuing careers in forensic medicine. The Graduate Medical Education Program Specialist will provide dedicated administrative and accreditation support across OCME’s fellowship programs, with a particular focus on maintaining compliance with Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) requirements and supporting the continued development of OCME’s graduate medical education programs.

The Graduate Medical Education Program Specialist will report directly to OCME’s Designated Institutional Official (DIO) and receive programmatic direction from the Associate Program Directors. The position will work closely with the Associate Program Directors, Program Coordinator, fellows, faculty and other OCME staff to support program administration and ensure accreditation requirements, documentation and deadlines are effectively managed. Work hours will vary throughout the academic year based on program activities, accreditation requirements, recruitment cycles, meetings and other fellowship needs. The successful candidate should be highly organized and detail oriented, with strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a complex academic and operational environment.

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Support the administration and coordination of OCME’s accredited fellowship programs, with a particular focus on ACGME accreditation, compliance and institutional requirements.
- Maintain a working knowledge of applicable ACGME Institutional Requirements, Common Program Requirements and specialty specific requirements, and monitor accreditation requirements, reporting obligations and deadlines.
- Maintain and manage required program and institutional information within the ACGME Accreditation Data System (ADS), including annual updates, surveys and other required submissions.
- Coordinate preparation for ACGME accreditation site visits, inspections and reviews, including assembling required documentation, coordinating logistics and preparing program leadership, faculty, fellows and staff.
- Provide administrative support for OCME’s Graduate Medical Education Committee (GMEC), including scheduling meetings, preparing agendas and supporting materials, taking and maintaining meeting minutes, maintaining required documentation and tracking action items.
- Support the DIO and Associate Program Directors in fulfilling institutional and program specific ACGME requirements, including annual program evaluations, Clinical Competency Committees, Program Evaluation Committees and other required activities.
- Coordinate and maintain fellow and faculty evaluations and track fellow educational activities, milestones, procedures, scholarly activities and other information required for accreditation and board certification.
- Support fellow recruitment, application, interview, selection, onboarding and offboarding processes, as well as administrative requirements related to credentialing, licensure and training.
- Coordinate educational and program activities, including didactic sessions, conferences, lectures, orientations and other fellowship activities, and maintain applicable program policies, agreements, affiliation documents and records.
- Work closely with the Program Coordinator and maintain effective communication with the DIO, Associate Program Directors, fellows, faculty, affiliated institutions and other stakeholders to support effective fellowship operations.
- Provide administrative support for faculty appointment and promotion processes, including coordinating required documentation, tracking submissions and maintaining applicable records.
- Support the rotations of visiting medical students, residents and other trainees at OCME, including scheduling, coordination, required documentation, institutional payments and related administrative processing.
- Assist with fellow scheduling and timekeeping, including the preparation and maintenance of schedules.
- Coordinate and support employee performance evaluations, including tracking completion and maintaining required documentation.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Senior SDET - Test Automation & Performance Engineering | Contract | Remote US
description:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior SDET / Test Automation Engineer for a project based assignment to build the automated testing and release systems that ensure our products remain reliable as traffic, data volume, integrations, partners, and release velocity increase. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on test automation, API and integration testing, performance and scalability testing, and CI/CD quality gates within an AWS-based environment.
This is not a manual QA position. You will design and build reusable test infrastructure, automate critical product and partner workflows, create realistic performance scenarios, and provide engineering teams with clear evidence of whether a release is ready for production.
You will work closely with engineering teams and the Performance & Reliability Engineering Lead to ensure quality and scalability are built into the development lifecycle rather than treated as a final release checkpoint.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and evolve the automated testing architecture across products and engineering teams
  • Build and maintain automated API, integration, contract, end-to-end, regression, and UI tests where appropriate
  • Develop reusable test frameworks, fixtures, synthetic data, mocks, and environment strategies
  • Build automated testing for distributed services and integrations running within AWS environments
  • Design and execute load, stress, spike, soak, scalability, degradation, and recovery tests
  • Translate performance and capacity scenarios into repeatable automated test suites with measurable pass/fail thresholds
  • Model realistic workloads, concurrency levels, traffic patterns, data volumes, and dependency behavior
  • Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish enforceable quality and release gates
  • Create automated release checks tied to quality, latency, reliability, and performance thresholds
  • Establish practices for identifying, quarantining, diagnosing, and eliminating flaky tests
  • Improve test observability and failure reporting so engineers can quickly understand and diagnose issues
  • Build and maintain reliable test data and test environment strategies
  • Debug failures across APIs, services, databases, infrastructure, and external integrations
  • Partner with Performance & Reliability Engineering to validate scalability assumptions and production readiness
  • Partner with Security Engineering on permissions, isolation, negative-path, and abuse-related test scenarios
  • Track testing trends and help reduce escaped defects, flaky tests, manual release effort, and regression risk
  • Coach engineers on testability, automation, quality ownership, and defect-prevention practices

Required Skills:

  • Strong experience as an SDET, Software Engineer in Test, Test Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, or similar engineering-focused testing role
  • Strong software development and test automation skills
  • Experience testing APIs, distributed services, integrations, and cloud-based applications
  • Hands-on experience working within AWS environments
  • Strong experience building automated API and integration test frameworks
  • Hands-on performance and scalability testing experience using tools such as k6, Gatling, Locust, JMeter, or equivalent
  • Experience designing realistic performance workloads rather than simply executing predefined load tests
  • Experience with load, stress, spike, soak, and scalability testing
  • Strong experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience establishing automated quality gates and release criteria
  • Experience with contract testing and testing across service boundaries
  • Strong understanding of test-data management, synthetic data, fixtures, mocks, and environment reliability
  • Experience using logs, metrics, traces, and other observability tools to diagnose test and system failures
  • Strong debugging skills across applications, APIs, infrastructure, databases, and integrations
  • Experience identifying and reducing flaky or unreliable automated tests
  • Ability to influence engineering teams and promote shared ownership of quality without becoming a centralized testing bottleneck

Nice to have:

  • Experience testing high-scale SaaS or distributed platforms
  • Experience with AWS services supporting highly available or distributed applications
  • Experience testing systems with significant traffic, concurrency, or availability requirements
  • Experience with resilience, failure injection, dependency degradation, or recovery testing
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and ephemeral or automated test environments
  • Experience with security-adjacent testing, including permissions, authentication, authorization, isolation, and negative-path scenarios
  • Identity, DNS, registry, or security domain experience
  • Experience building quality or test platforms used across multiple engineering teams

What Success Looks Like
Within your first several months, you will have:

  • Established a clear risk-based automation strategy across critical product and partner workflows
  • Built reliable automated regression, API, integration, and contract test coverage
  • Created repeatable performance and scalability tests for the platform's highest-risk journeys
  • Established realistic test-data and environment strategies
  • Integrated critical test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines
  • Implemented measurable release gates tied to quality, latency, reliability, and performance thresholds
  • Reduced flaky tests and improved the clarity and actionability of automated test failures
  • Established performance trend reporting and repeatable load, soak, and failure-testing capabilities
  • Reduced manual release validation and increased confidence in production readiness
  • Helped establish shared quality ownership across engineering teams

title: FOIL Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE CAMPAIGN FINANCE BOARD

The Campaign Finance Board is a nonpartisan, independent city agency that empowers New Yorkers to have a greater impact on their elections. Our mission is to make local democracy more open, transparent, and equitable by removing barriers to participation.

We make it easier for New Yorkers to vote, meaningfully support candidates for city office, and run for office themselves. NYC Votes, our voter engagement initiative, meets people where they are to share trustworthy election information and help New Yorkers make a plan to vote. We publish the citywide Voter Guide, which delivers information about candidates directly to voters’ doors. Our public matching funds program ensures small contributions can make a big difference, allowing regular people to run for office by relying on the support of other regular people, not just wealthy donors and special interests. And we lift the veil on how candidates raise and spend money, increasing transparency and accountability in local government.

We believe that when every New Yorker is empowered to participate meaningfully in elections, candidates will better reflect the communities they serve, elected leaders will be more accountable to the public, and New Yorkers will have a democracy they can truly trust.

ABOUT THE UNIT

Campaign Affairs Division

Campaign Affairs (CA) is comprised of the Candidate & Committee Services and Records, Data & Information units. Together, these units are responsible for the CFB’s direct engagement with anyone regulated under the city’s matching funds program – candidates, campaigns, independent spenders, and non-candidate committees – as well as the agency’s records, data, and information management and responses to requests under the Freedom of Information Law (FOIL).

Record, Data, Information Unit

Records, Data, and Information unit performs all phases of data and documentation intake across the agency, including the release and reconciliation of candidate financial disclosure submissions, amendments, and audit responses. They perform data entry for all incoming candidates and provide quality control of the data. They also perform all phases of records intake and scanning/importing documentation to support our agency’s auditing and enforcement mandates. This unit is responsible for identifying, compiling, analyzing, and redacting responsive records for Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) requests and saving the responsive records in an online accessible filing system for internal review and external production. This unit is also responsible for the agency’s records retention policies and procedures for both onsite paper and electronic records.

JOB DESCRIPTION

This role is to coordinate, and process Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) requests in accordance with New York State Public Officers Law, agency policies, and records management requirements. The incumbent will serve as a key liaison between agency departments to ensure the timely identification, retrieval, review, redaction, and release of responsive records and supports records management using the OpenRecords FOIL Portal and SharePoint.

The responsibilities and tasks to be completed in this role include, but are not limited to:

- Managing the full cycle of FOIL requests, including intake, tracking, records retrieval, records review, redaction, and disclosure preparation.

- Maintaining accurate tracking logs, monitoring statutory deadlines, coordinating records searches across multiple divisions and facilitating quality assurance review with Legal.

- Ensuring all request-related activities are properly documented and maintained in accordance with agency policies and records retention requirements.

- Compiling FOIL-related data and records to support internal tracking, reporting requirements, and transparency efforts.

- Serving as business owner of FOIL needs for process improvement changes that involve new technology including updates and adoption of applications such as OnBase, OpenRecords, and other future enhancements to the CFB website that would produce FOIL-related records proactively.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES & OTHER BEHAVIORS (KSAOs)

We're seeking individuals eager to make an impact, even if they don't tick every box on our job description. We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and the unique blend of lived experiences, non-traditional education pathways, practical know-how, and a variety of skills and abilities that each candidate brings to the table. If you're ready to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply and be part of our dynamic team.

Knowledge

- Knowledge of New York State Freedom of Information Law requirements, statutory response timelines, and protocols for processing FOIL requests.

- Knowledge of confidentiality requirements, privacy protections, and disclosure limitations.

- Knowledge of electronic records systems and document management practices.

- Knowledge of redaction standards and confidentiality requirements.

- Knowledge of file naming conventions and document organization standards.

Skills

- Skill in locating, researching, and completing responsive records from electronic and physical recordkeeping systems while ensuring completeness and accuracy.

- Skill in organizing, maintaining, and securing electronic records in accordance with records retention schedules, and agency policies.

- Skill in written and basic verbal communication, particularly when addressing questions or needing clarification.

- Skill in reviewing and redacting records accurately to protect sensitive information.

- Skill in managing high-volume FOIL requests efficiently.

Abilities

- Ability to organize and prioritize high volume FOIL requests and monitor approaching deadlines.

- Ability to work independently while managing multiple assignments and deadlines.

- Ability to manage multiple FOIL requests simultaneously while prioritizing competing deadlines.

- Ability to collaborate effectively with staff and communicate complex information clearly and professionally.

- Ability to follow established procedures and adapt to updated processes.

Other Characteristics

- Demonstrates a willingness to work cooperatively with staff across divisions.

- Demonstrates patience, accuracy, and thoroughness when reviewing large volumes of records, applying redactions, and preparing responsive records.

- Takes responsibility for assigned FOIL requests, follows through on commitments, monitors deadlines, and promptly address errors, delays, or incomplete work.

- Exercises discretion and respects the confidential nature of protected, personal, privileged and legally exempt information.

- Demonstrates persistence in resolving records retrieval challenges, identifying missing information, and working through obstacles that may affect timely FOIL processing.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

These are qualifications that would be helpful, but are not essential to being successful in the role. Candidates with these qualifications will be given preference in the selection process.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills. Demonstrate sound judgment when handling sensitive information and can manage multiple requests and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience using OpenRecords, Dropbox, SharePoint or other approved secure file-sharing platform(s) to create links, organize electronic disclosure packages, and securely transmit responsive records.

- Experience identifying, locating, retrieving, and extracting responsive records from electronic software applications, databases, email systems, shared drives, and document repositories.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

- While completing the application, candidates are invited to provide a cover letter via “attachment” or the “Message to the Hiring Team” field on SmartRecruiters.

ANALYST CFB AL 2&3 ONLY - 0660A

1. A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college including or supplemented by at least twelve-semester credits (or the equivalent of twelve-semester credits) in accounting, auditing, business or public administration, computer science, economics, finance, statistics, graphic design, personnel or human resources administration, user experience design, or a closely related area of study and one year of satisfactory full-time experience in accounting, auditing (including compliance or investigative auditing), business or public administration, business analysis, computer science, database administration, economics, finance, fiscal or economic management or research, statistics, graphic design, personnel or human resources administration, user experience design, or a closely related field; or

2. A four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent and five years of experience as described in “1” above; or

3. Education and/or experience equivalent to “1” above.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
På vegne af Frameo søger vi en Senior Backend Developer, der vil sætte et tydeligt aftryk på den backend, som binder virksomhedens globale platform sammen. Du kombinerer hands‑on udvikling med teknisk sparring og stærke arkitekturbeslutninger og får reel indflydelse på, hvordan Frameos backend skal skaleres, styrkes og udvikles i takt med virksomhedens fortsatte vækst.

Du er ikke kun med til at diskutere løsningerne, du bygger dem. Med hænderne i koden og blikket på helheden er du med til at gøre Frameos backend hurtigere, stærkere og lettere at udvikle videre på. Samtidig løfter du teamet gennem skarp sparring, tydelige standarder og løsninger, der holder i praksis.

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Udvikle og videreudvikle Frameos backend-services og API-lag
  • Drive udviklingen af en skalerbar, sikker og vedligeholdelsesvenlig backend-arkitektur
  • Sætte standarder for kodekvalitet, test, dokumentation og struktureret udvikling
  • Sikre, at tekniske beslutninger er velovervejede, dokumenterede og implementeres effektivt
  • Omsætte forretningsbehov og produktroadmaps til konkrete tekniske prioriteringer
  • Identificere og håndtere teknisk gæld på en struktureret og proaktiv måde
  • Sparre med og mentorerne kolleger gennem code reviews, videndeling og faglig dialog
  • Bidrage til stabile produktionsmiljøer gennem solide DevOps-principper og CI/CD-processer
  • Følge den teknologiske udvikling og vurdere, hvornår nye værktøjer, metoder og AI-løsninger skaber reel værdi.

Med direkte reference til Head of Tech, Jette Collie, bliver du en del af Frameos Tech-team på 21 medarbejdere med kompetencer inden for app-udvikling, backend, QA, infrastruktur og platform.

Backend-profil med blik for hele stacken

Vi forestiller os, at du har minimum fem års erfaring med backend-udvikling, gerne fra en produkt, software- eller platformsvirksomhed. Du har stærke kompetencer i Kotlin og erfaring med microservices og REST API-design, herunder versionering og dokumentation i Swagger eller OpenAPI. Du er vant til at arbejde med tokenbaseret adgangsstyring og ved, hvordan følsomme data skal beskyttes. Du arbejder struktureret med test, Git og versionsstyring. TDD eller en tilsvarende testpraksis er en naturlig del af dit arbejde – ikke fordi det står i en guide, men fordi det gør koden bedre og løsningerne mere robuste.

Du har solid erfaring med Docker og moderne CI/CD-praksis og er vant til at få kode sikkert og effektivt hele vejen i produktion. Frameo kører sine services i Docker Swarm, så erfaring med containerorkestrering i Swarm eller Kubernetes er et stort plus. Jenkins og DigitalOcean er en del af hverdagen, og du ved, hvordan et stabilt setup skal skrues sammen. Samtidig er AI‑værktøjer er en naturlig del af udviklingsarbejdet hos Frameo – blandt andet Claude Code. Derfor er det en fordel, hvis du allerede bruger den type værktøjer til at arbejde hurtigere, skarpere og mere effektivt i din udvikling.

Kode i hænderne, teamet i ryggen

Du tager naturligt ansvar og trives med at være tæt på både koden og de beslutninger, der former produktet. Du udfordrer det eksisterende, når noget kan gøres bedre, og skaber opbakning til nye tekniske retninger gennem dialog, faglig tyngde og godt samarbejde med teamet. Samtidig har du blik for sammenhængen mellem teknologi, produkt og forretning og formår at holde kvaliteten høj, også når tempoet stiger.

Du deler din viden, løfter dem omkring dig og ser det som en naturlig del af rollen at gøre både løsningerne og teamet stærkere. AI‑værktøjer er allerede en del af din arbejdsdag, og du bruger dem aktivt til at arbejde skarpere, hurtigere og mere effektivt. Du vil passe godt ind i en ambitiøs og uformel scale-up, hvor der er høje standarder, korte beslutningsveje og plads til at tage ansvar.

Om Frameo

Frameo er en internationalt orienteret tech-virksomhed, som har skabt verdens førende platform til deling af billeder og videoer på digitale fotorammer. Frameo samarbejder med mere end 100 fabrikker i Kina og anvendes i over 130 lande. Virksomheden oplever markant vækst, har mere end 20 millioner app-downloads og en af markedets højeste brugerratings. Frameo kombinerer entreprenant energi med en stærk teknologisk løsning og står foran en vækstfase, hvor organisationen skal udvikles fra scale-up til en mere etableret og professionelt drevet virksomhed.

For mere information: https://www.frameo.com

title: Lead Researcher, Cultural & Consumer Insights
description:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.

About the Role

Hinge is hiring a Lead Researcher to join our Cultural & Consumer Insights team. This role is the lead quantitative research partner to our Global Communications team, with a secondary focus supporting Product Marketing. This role requires a PhD in a behavioral science field (e.g., psychology, sociology, relationship science, behavioral economics, communications) along with strong quantitative research chops: you know how to design a survey that's methodologically sound enough to stand behind publicly (in press, in reports, in front of leadership), and thoughtful enough to be a genuinely good experience for the daters taking it. You have a proven ability to translate data into insights and stories that provoke new thinking and drive action, and you're energized by the idea of helping daters see their approach to dating in a new light.

You'll partner closely with Communications and Product Marketing, translating big, sometimes ambiguous strategic questions ("What is a conversation-worthy behavior amongst GenZ daters") into sharp, actionable survey design and quantitative analysis. One week you'll be uncovering and socializing insights that shape our global consumer reports; the next you'll be partnering with Product Marketing to test feature sentiment or messaging with users. While this role primarily supports Marketing, Communications, and Product Marketing, the insights you generate will often extend well beyond the team, feeding into product initiatives, and will ultimately shape experiences for daters across the globe.

This role calls for someone who is highly collaborative, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and energized by moving fluidly between high-level strategic thinking and the technical details of quantitative survey design, analysis, and storytelling.


Responsibilities

  • Survey Strategy & Design: Bring behavioral science and cultural expertise, especially on how Gen Z relates to dating, identity, and connection, into early brainstorms with Comms and Product Marketing, helping shape raw ideas and themes into sharp, well-defined research questions and exploration areas.

  • Quantitative Craft: Design and field rigorous, creative surveys that translate those questions into precise instruments, ones that are also a genuinely good experience for daters.

  • Ongoing Insight Synthesis: Run analysis as learnings emerge (not just at the end), keeping collaborators informed and engaged along the way, bringing the team on the ride with the data, even though final story and report ownership sits elsewhere.

  • Signature Initiatives: Power efforts like the Global DATE Reports (GenZ + LGBTQIA), localized data stories in markets outside the US, and product marketing launches (value proposition testing, feature sentiment).

  • Strategic Partnership: Act as a close, trusted partner to Communications and Product Marketing, embedding insights work directly into their strategy and planning, and connecting opportunities across Marketing and Product.

  • Innovation in Quant Storytelling: Stay curious about what's next, experimenting with new survey formats, question design, and analysis approaches to push Hinge's quantitative storytelling forward.

  • Vendor Management: Direct external research and strategy agencies, providing clear briefs and strategic direction aligned to CCI's goals.

Within Three Months We Expect You To:

  • Develop a strong understanding of storytelling at Hinge and build processes to support it by collaborating with marketing partners on a data-driven, consumer-facing story.

  • Build strong, trusted, collaborative relationships with key partners across Communications and Product Marketing, including marketing managers in US + European + LATAM markets.

  • Develop a research roadmap around key marketing moments in close collaboration with marketing partners.


What We're Looking For

  • PhD in a behavioral science field (relationship science, psychology, sociology, behavioral economics, communications, or related discipline), with formal training in research methods and quantitative analysis.

  • Passion and curiosity about dating culture and our mission of inspiring intimate connections to create a less lonely world.

  • 5+ years of post-PhD applied consumer research experience, with deep expertise in quantitative survey design, able to craft surveys that are methodologically sound and genuinely engaging for respondents.

  • Experience designing research for external audiences, including press coverage, branded reports, and thought leadership.

  • You’re an expert at defining the right questions: you can synthesize diverse perspectives and cultural observations into sharply defined research questions and areas of exploration

  • Expert data storyteller with a proven ability to find the story in the data and make insights accessible and compelling

  • Extremely collaborative, low-ego partner who thrives working shoulder-to-shoulder with Marketing and Product Marketing teams, who is comfortable operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

  • Mixed-methods research expertise, with strong quantitative survey experience as a core strength, complemented by qualitative experience is a plus (in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation).

  • Champions team culture in authentic, courageous, and empathic ways.

  • Cross-cultural or cross-market research experience is a plus: you've run studies beyond the US and know how to identify and contrast cultural nuances.


$ 207000- $254000 a year
Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in New York City. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.

Professional Growth: Get an annual Learning & Development stipend once you’ve been with us for three months. You also get free access to Udemy, an online learning and teaching marketplace with over 6000 courses, starting your first day.

ERGs: We have eight Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)—Asian, Unapologetic, Disability, LGBTQIA+, Raices, Women/Nonbinary, Parents —that hold regular meetings, host events, and provide dedicated support to the organization & its community.

Empathy: We deeply consider the perspective of others.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Our team is delivering business solutions with Machine Learning and Data Science often turning them into scalable platforms including non-trivial and innovative solutions in the space of Forecasting and Customer Analytics often leveraging cutting-edge Causality frameworks. Example projects in this area: Next Best Offer/Action, propensity modeling, churn modeling, forecasting of demand and sales, revenue growth management, etc. This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, and the ability to understand their problems and translate them into machine learning ones.

Tasks:

  • Work on end-to-end classification and forecasting use cases: problem framing, data preparation, model development, evaluation and basic deployment support (e.g. demand forecasting, churn prediction).
  • Explore and clean data; perform EDA to understand data and flag data quality issues.
  • Engineer features for tabular and time-series data.
  • Train, validate, and tune standard ML models (e.g. logistic regression, tree-based models, gradient boosting, simple neural nets, classical time-series models).
  • Evaluate models with appropriate metrics that have impact on business KPIs.
  • Build clear visualizations and concise reports to present model results and insights to business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and AI engineers to bring models into production (batch scoring, APIs, models monitoring, dashboards).
  • Document data sources, modeling assumptions, and experiment results in a reproducible way (notebooks, reports, wikis).
  • Business understanding and translating problems into technical goals by defining success metrics, auditing data feasibility, and aligning stakeholder expectations.
  • Pre-sales activities (at senior consultant level).

Requirements:

  • Commercial experience with various classical data science and Machine Learning (ML) models (e.g. decision trees, ensemble-based tree models, linear regression etc.).

  • Solid knowledge of customer analytics concepts or advanced forecasting.

  • Model hyperparameter tuning.

  • Model validation frameworks.

  • Experience with business requirements gathering, transforming them into technical plan, data processing, feature engineering, models evaluation.

  • Previous experience in an analytical role supporting business will be a plus.

  • Fluency in Python, basic working knowledge of SQL.

  • Knowledge of specific DS/ML libraries.

  • Solid experience in one of the cloud computing platforms (Databricks or GCP or Azure).


What Will Set You Apart:

  • Understanding of Causal machine learning.
  • Experience in working with big data and distributed environments would be a plus.
  • Commercial experience proven by multiple successful projects in the areas of forecasting would be a big plus.
  • Experience with OOP in Python.
  • Experience with MLOps.
  • Familiarity with other languages R, Scala would be a plus.

General:

  • Basic computer programming skills and familiarity with programming concepts.
  • Strong business acumen.
  • Experience with deep learning, reinforcement learning or other advanced modeling concepts in Classical Data Science problems.
  • Ability to come up with creative solutions to address customer problems.

title: JADC2 Operations Subject Matter Expert
description:
Title:

JADC2 Operations Subject Matter Expert

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

Why Join Us?

  • Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.

  • Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of Joint and multi-domain operations.

Key Responsibilities:

KBR is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) Operations Subject Matter Expert (SME) to join a dynamic, high-performing, multidisciplinary team of military domain SMEs, modelers, and analysts located in Northern Virginia. This team leverages advanced modeling, simulation, and analysis (MS&A) tools and techniques to shape and inform Concept Exploration, Course of Action Analysis, and Operational Planning efforts for Department of War (DoW) stakeholders. The ideal candidate shall:
• Apply your expert knowledge of current and emerging battle management command and control (BMC2) concepts, Air or Integrated Tasking Orders (ATO or ITO), and related doctrinal concepts to support mission-level MS&A activities.
• Develop BMC2 structures and concepts of operations (CONOPS) for use by modelers and other operational SMEs in the MS&A environment.
• Drive innovation by bridging traditional operational planning and novel analytical approaches through creative and critical thinking.
• Leverage your deep understanding of joint, multi-domain military capabilities, BMC2 concepts, and employment frameworks to evaluate the execution of kill chains and kill webs.
• Collect, analyze, and curate authoritative military information—including doctrine, planning materials, and capability documents—in a “smart” knowledge management environment that enables enterprise-wide insight and collaboration.
• Translate doctrine, tactics, techniques, and procedures into actionable products to inform model, behavior, and simulation software development.
• Deliver high-quality, high-impact written, visual, and analytical deliverables that inform senior decision-making.
• Lead small teams or tasks in support of the broader overall effort.

Work Environment:

  • Location: Reston, VA

  • Travel Requirements: Minimal 0-20%, supporting strong work-life balance

  • Working Hours: Standard

A Senior Small Business Banking Consultant is responsible for meeting the needs of Small Business clients that are domiciled in the Consumer Bank. description:
Job Description Summary

About the role
Ready to bring your skills into a role where your thinking, problem-solving and technical curiosity can help power the future?
Our Lead Control & Protection Engineer role offers someone with transferable strengths, fresh perspectives and the drive to learn the opportunity to grow and make an impact on the energy transition.
This role would suit an engineer with strong systems thinking, modelling, analysis, and technical leadership skills who wants to apply their expertise in a new domain. You may come from adjacent industries such as power systems, electrical engineering, automation, simulation, controls, protection, rail, aerospace, oil and gas, utilities, or other complex engineering environments where safety, reliability, and technical rigour are essential.
