What you will do:
• Lead and contribute to the design, modelling, verification, and validation of control and protection functions
• Build and use simulation models to assess system behaviour and performance
• Review technical solutions, identify risks, and propose safe, reliable, and compliant approaches
• Support dynamic performance studies and investigate system behaviour under fault and disturbance conditions
Technical Skills we are looking for:
• An understanding of how HVDC systems support the reliable transfer of power and the core elements that bring the system together.
• The ability to read simple technical diagrams and understand the role of key equipment, signals and interfaces within a system.
• Confidence in building and running simple models with guidance, checking results carefully and using data to support clear, reliable conclusions.
• A structured approach to control system configuration, testing and troubleshooting, with an understanding of how information moves through a system.
• The ability to support routine studies, interpret results and spot when outputs need closer review or further investigation.

About you:
We’re looking for someone who enjoys working with others, takes ownership and turns complex information into practical action. Someone who looks for better ways of working, brings ideas that improve how we deliver, stays motivated when priorities change and adapts quickly to new challenges. In this role, you help shape reliable solutions that make a real difference to our customers and the energy transition.
You do not need to have worked in HVDC before if you can demonstrate the right transferable skills, a strong learning mindset, and the ability to work with complex systems.


Why join us:
This is a chance to work on complex, high-impact engineering challenges with a collaborative team. You’ll have the opportunity to develop deep specialist knowledge while bringing fresh thinking from outside the industry and develop existing and new skills.

title: Change Management Consultant – Financial Transformation & AI Adoption
description:
Job Description - Change Management Consultant – Financial Transformation & AI Adoption

Role Overview

The client is seeing a consultant to support the Finance team’s journey with deriving productivity from Copilot Premium and Claude. They want a competitive person with expertise in Finance domain and AI adoption using Claude + Copilot.


This role is designed for a senior business transformation professional with deep Finance domain expertise who can engage effectively with Finance leadership, understand business challenges, and drive organizational change. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor, helping the organization navigate its AI adoption journey (Claude and Copilot) while ensuring business value is realized through people, process, and technology transformation.

The focus is on enabling business transformation, fostering stakeholder adoption, identifying high-value AI opportunities, and embedding AI into Finance operations through effective change management and strategic engagement.

Location – Cheshire, UK

Duration – Initially 8 weeks

Work type – Onsite


Key Responsibilities

Change Management & AI Adoption

  • Lead the change management strategy for AI adoption across the Finance function using Claude and Copilot Premium.
  • Develop and execute stakeholder engagement, communication, and business readiness plans.
  • Drive organizational adoption of AI by promoting new ways of working and helping teams embrace change.
  • Identify and address change impacts, risks, and resistance to ensure successful adoption.
  • Design and deliver workshops, awareness sessions, and training programmes to build AI understanding and confidence.
  • Define adoption success metrics and monitor business outcomes to ensure sustainable change.

Financial Transformation

  • Partner with Finance leadership to understand strategic priorities, operational challenges, and transformation objectives.
  • Assess current Finance processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through process redesign, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Support Finance transformation initiatives by aligning business processes with future operating models.
  • Advocate continuous improvement and operational excellence across Finance functions.

AI Use Case Discovery & Business Consulting

  • Facilitate discovery workshops with Finance stakeholders to identify business pain points and AI opportunities.
  • Translate business challenges into practical AI-enabled solutions and transformation initiatives.
  • Identify, prioritize, and develop a roadmap of high-value AI use cases aligned to business objectives.
  • Support the development of business cases and Proof of Value (PoV) initiatives.
  • Work alongside Digital, Data, and Technology teams to ensure AI solutions address genuine business needs.

Executive Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with Finance executives and senior business stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary liaison between Finance, Technology, Data, and Transformation teams.
  • Facilitate executive workshops to align business priorities with AI transformation objectives.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts in business language suitable for non-technical audiences.
  • Influence decision-making through structured recommendations and business-focused insights.

Transformation Governance

  • Support governance of Finance transformation and AI adoption initiatives.
  • Track adoption, business benefits, and value realization against agreed KPIs.
  • Collaborate with programme management teams to ensure successful delivery.
  • Contribute to the development of long-term AI adoption and transformation roadmaps.

Required Experience

  • 10–15+ years of experience in Change Management, Finance Transformation, or Business Transformation.
  • Strong Finance domain expertise with experience working across core Finance processes.
  • Proven track record of leading large-scale business transformation and organizational change initiatives.
  • Experience engaging with CFOs, Finance Directors, and senior business stakeholders.
  • Strong workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive user adoption and embed new ways of working.

· AI & Technology Knowledge - Candidates should possess a practical understanding of:

· Generative AI and Agentic AI

· Microsoft Copilot and Claude

· AI adoption strategies and business enablement

· Responsible AI and AI governance principles

· Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) strongly preferred; must be able to hold a technical finance discussion with a qualified CFO.

· Hands-on depth in specific finance processes: record-to-report and close, reconciliations, treasury and cash forecasting, AP/AR, financial control - with the ability to assess them critically, not merely facilitate discussion about them.

· Familiarity with commodity or asset-heavy process-industry finance (inventory/working-capital financing, hedging, duty/excise, borrowing-base and covenant reporting) is a strong advantage.



The role does not require software development or AI engineering experience but does require the ability to identify where AI can create measurable business value.

Preferred Industry Experience

Experience within one or more of the following sectors is desirable:

  • Energy
  • Oil & Gas
  • Manufacturing
  • Utilities
  • Chemicals
  • Large Enterprise Organizations

Core Competencies

  • Change Management
  • Financial Transformation
  • AI Adoption Strategy
  • Organizational Change
  • Executive Stakeholder Management
  • Business Consulting
  • Workshop Facilitation
  • Business Process Improvement
  • Communication & Influencing
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Value Realization

Success Measures

The successful candidate will:

  • Successfully drive AI adoption across the Finance organization using Claude and Copilot.
  • Build trusted relationships with Finance leadership and key business stakeholders.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in user adoption, productivity, and business outcomes.
  • Identify and prioritize a pipeline of high-value AI use cases.
  • Establish sustainable change management practices that embed AI into everyday Finance operations.
  • Help create a long-term roadmap for AI-enabled Finance transformation and continuous improvement.

title: GenAI Biosecurity Expert
description:
Description

As a GenAI Biosecurity Expert, you will play a critical role in evaluating and strengthening the safety guardrails of Generative AI systems. You will combine deep subject-matter expertise in the biological sciences with hands-on prompt research, red-teaming, and model pairing to identify dual-use risks, prevent the proliferation of biological threats, and ensure AI outputs adhere to strict biosecurity and biosafety standards.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct hands-on adversarial red-teaming and risk evaluations to stress-test AI models against biological vulnerabilities, translating domain expertise and regulatory standards into actionable feedback for model safety alignment.

Stay current on emerging biotechnology research, biological threat vectors, and biosecurity governance to continually update safety benchmarks.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Location: Must be located in and authorized to work within the United States (excluding Illinois and Texas).
  • Education: Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Microbiology, Virology, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, or a closely related biological field (Master’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience considered).
  • Subject-Matter Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on or research experience with biological risk assessment, biosafety practices, or biosecurity governance.
  • AI Safety Aptitude: Strong enthusiasm and comfort with hands-on prompt engineering, red-teaming, and evaluating LLM outputs.
  • Analytical Skills: Excellent scientific rigor, attention to detail, and ability to distinguish safe educational context from actionable dual-use risk.
  • Communication: Ability to articulate complex scientific risks clearly to technical AI safety and alignment teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of AI prompt engineering concepts and practices, including adversarial prompt writing
  • Familiarity with current frontier AI safety benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, and ethical guidelines for GenAI.
  • Expertise in one or more of the following biological risk areas:
  • Pathogen Analysis & Viromics: Deep understanding of high-consequence pathogens (e.g., Ebola, Smallpox, Influenza) and host-pathogen interactions.
  • Dual-Use Biotech & Genetic Modification: Hands-on or theoretical familiarity with CRISPR, synthetic biology, gene editing hazards, and gain-of-function research.
  • Toxin Research & Biomanufacturing: Practical knowledge of DNA/RNA synthesis screening protocols, toxin research, and bioreactor scale-up risks.

The salary range for this role is $150K - $178K OTE - Range may vary based on experience. Salary at the time of offer will be commensurate with experience.

title: Deputy Commissioner of Forensic Laboratories/Chief of Laboratories
description:
The Office of Chief Medical Examiner (OCME) investigates cases of persons who die within New York City from criminal violence, by accident, by suicide, suddenly when in apparent health, when unattended by a physician, in a correctional facility or in any suspicious or unusual manner or where an application is made pursuant to law for a permit to cremate a body of a person.

Our core purpose is to protect public health and serve impartial justice through forensic science and medicine. We exist to provide answers in support of families and communities during times of profound need.
The core values of CARES guide our work for communities and inform our behavior toward each other and all those we serve.
- Commitment: Dedicated to the mission at all times
- Accountability: Responsible to each other and the community
- Resilience: Adapt in the face of adversity
- Excellence: Achieve and maintain the highest quality
- Service: Innovate to meet evolving needs

OCME seeks an experienced executive leader to serve as Deputy Commissioner of Forensic Laboratories / Chief of Laboratories. Reporting directly to the First Deputy Commissioner, the Deputy Commissioner provides executive leadership, administrative oversight, and strategic direction for OCME’s laboratory portfolio. Each laboratory is led by a Laboratory Director responsible for its day-to-day scientific, technical, quality, and operational management. The Deputy Commissioner works across the laboratory leadership team to ensure appropriate coordination, resources, administrative support, and alignment with agency priorities.

As a member of OCME’s Executive Leadership Team, the Deputy Commissioner serves as the principal executive responsible for laboratory administration and represents the laboratories in agencywide planning, decision making, and strategic initiatives.

The duties and responsibilities of the Deputy Commissioner include, but are not limited to:
- Provides executive direction and managerial oversight for departments within the forensic laboratory portfolio, which currently includes Forensic Biology, Forensic Toxicology, Molecular Genetics, Histology, Evidence, and Laboratory Administration, comprising approximately 300 forensic scientists, managers, supervisors, and administrative and support personnel.
- Participates in OCME’s Executive Leadership Team, contributing to the agency’s vision, strategic direction, and priorities, and serves as a member of the Executive Tactical Team, representing the day-to-day interests and needs of the forensic laboratories while supporting the First Deputy Commissioner and fellow Executive Tactical Team members in policy development, executive decision making, and the day-to-day management and operations of the agency.
- Leads strategic planning, administration, personnel management, and budgetary oversight for the forensic laboratory portfolio, working in close coordination with Laboratory Directors responsible for the day-to-day scientific, technical, quality, and operational management of their respective laboratories.
- Provides executive oversight of quality assurance, accreditation, and regulatory compliance across the laboratories, working with the respective Laboratory Directors to ensure adherence to applicable standards and New York State Commission on Forensic Science requirements.
- Monitors laboratory performance, turnaround times, workloads, quality measures, and other key performance indicators, working with Laboratory Directors to address trends, backlogs, operational challenges, and areas requiring executive attention.
- Directs and supports Laboratory Directors in advancing major laboratory initiatives and long-term planning for operations, equipment, facilities, infrastructure, and capital needs, including equipment maintenance, replacement, procurement, and major capital purchases.
- Provides executive oversight and support to Laboratory Directors in the management of laboratory budgets, expenditures, contracts, procurement, and resource allocation, and works with the Directors to develop and advance new needs and funding requests.

description:

The HIV/AIDS Services Administration (HASA) is the most comprehensive program of its kind in the country, helping New Yorkers living with HIV or AIDS live healthier and more independent lives. We assist with an individualized service plan that targets the support and necessary benefits that are specific to a client’s medical situation that will enhance his or her well-being. HASA provides intensive case management, rental assistance, emergency and non-emergency housing, and assistance with applying for public benefits and services including Medicaid, food stamps and cash assistance. HASA also provides vocational services that prepare clients for work. With counselors to help identify barriers to employment, clients can select vocational goals and receive support. Other HASA’s services include home care and homemaking services, mental health and substance abuse screening and treatment referrals, transportation assistance, referrals to community-based organizations, and SSI or SSD application and appeal.


HIV/Aids Services Administration is recruiting one (1) Administrative Staff Analyst NM I who will function as a Special Assistant to the Deputy Commissioner. The Special Assistant will:

Under the direction of the Deputy Commissioner, with wide latitude for independent judgment and decision making, is responsible for various aspects which assist in the achievement of the program’s goals and objectives. The Special Assistant to the Deputy Commissioner will oversee the analysis of sensitive, often controversial issues and problems involving HASA’s client population, with a view to resolving these issues. Based on surveys and studies, this position will also recommend new policies and procedures to provide efficient services to HASA’s clientele.

- Assist the Deputy Commissioner in the promotion, maintenance, and achievement of program goals, objectives, and programs related to the delivery of services within mandated local, State and Federal regulations and guidelines.

- Direct the analysis of sensitive, often controversial issues and problems involving HASA client population, and prepares responses to public, governmental, and community organizations.

- Direct the maintenance of the control tracking system for the Deputy Commissioner, which prioritizes incoming requests for information, including developing and implementing controls of top priority items to ensure accountability for activity and performance.

- Direct the conduct of analysis of the impact of proposed changes in services upon the HASA client population. Formulates and conducts studies and surveys and recommends new procedures and policy changes to provide for more efficient functioning of HASA Programs and achievement of greater cost effectiveness.

- Oversee the conduct of management studies and analysis to determine the impact of local, Federal, and State legislation upon the HASA program. Prepares drafts and assists the Deputy Commissioner in the implementation of policies, procedures, methods, or systems. Provides the Agency's managerial staff with proper interpretation and application of policies and regulations.

- Oversee the design, implementation, and operation of special projects. Recommend procedural and operational changes and prepare reports as required. Monitors the progress of such projects to ensure successful completion and evaluates project effectiveness.

- Maintain liaison with the Office of the Inspector General (OIG) and the Office of Legal Affairs (OLA) to ensure compliance with investigations.

- Act as a liaison between the Deputy Commissioner and staff members from the various components of MICSA; signs documents within delegated authority; and represents the Deputy Commissioner on an as-needed basis at meetings.

title: Product Manager (Match Group AI)
description:
Match Group AI Team Introduction

Match Group AI (MG AI) is the central tech organization that drives innovation across Match Group's global portfolio, including Tinder, Hinge, Azar, Pairs, Match, BLK, etc. Match Group aims to spark meaningful connections for everyone, worldwide, and the MG AI team's role is to bring cutting-edge AI to unblock the challenges along that journey, across diverse domains (e.g., Recommendation, Trust & Safety, Profile Enhancement).

Unlike brand-specific teams (e.g., Tinder, HYPERCONNECT AI), MG AI team offers the unique opportunity to impact the entire Match Group ecosystem. You won't just build for one app; we aim to develop scalable AI solutions that power Tinder, Hinge, and beyond, defining the technological gold standard for the global dating industry.

  • Detailed article: Introduction to Match Group AI Team (written in Korean)

Working as a Product Manager at MG AI

While engineers focus on building and shipping models, Product Managers at MG AI own the why and the what. We translate complex, often ambiguous business challenges from Match Group's brands into clear ML product strategy, and we drive execution across a globally distributed team. The PMs who thrive here are strategic troubleshooters with a bias for action: they spot what is blocking progress and drive it to resolution instead of waiting.

This is a communication-first role, but that does not mean coordination alone. Your core job is to figure out which problem is worth solving, articulate it in clear and precise language, and drive alignment among a diverse set of stakeholders across cultures and time zones. You own the product thinking end to end: framing the problem, shaping the plan, and defining what we build.

You will work on projects that leverage a wide range of technologies, from on-device ML modules to server-side AI models and LLMs. You do not need to be an ML expert on day one, but you must learn fast and become technically fluent enough to make sound product calls, because the technology and the problems keep changing.


What You'll Do
  • Frame the Problem: Figure out which problems are worth solving and why, and articulate them in clear, precise language that a diverse team can rally around.
  • Shape the Roadmap: Decide what matters most, sequence the work, make the tradeoffs, and write PRDs, keeping partners aligned as priorities shift.
  • Navigate Complex Stakeholder Maps: Act as the connective tissue between Match Group's brands, and the many functions within them, and MG AI engineering. Read the unspoken dynamics, build alignment across brands, functions, cultures, and time zones, and keep everyone moving in the same direction.
  • Hands-on Execution: Stay deeply involved in the details. Use experiments, behavioral data, and research to guide your calls when signals are imperfect, unblock engineering, and make the small decisions that keep a project moving.

Required Qualifications
  • Exceptional Communication & Stakeholder Management (most important): You excel at managing stakeholders in complex, high-ambiguity situations. You read between the lines, sense interpersonal and organizational dynamics, and build alignment across teams with competing priorities. This is the single most important quality for this role.
  • 4-6 years of product management experience in the Tech domain, ideally on complex systems or data or ML-driven products.
  • Fast Learning Curve & Strong Will to Learn: You do not need to be ML-savvy today, but you must ramp quickly and become technically fluent enough to shape direction on model behavior and tradeoffs without needing to be deeply technical.
  • Fluent in English (Able to conduct business meetings and participate in complex discussions without requiring assistance.)
  • Fluent in Korean (Sophisticated professional interactions with native-level precision and an understanding of cultural nuances.) Essential for cross-functional collaboration within the Seoul office.
  • Strong Ownership & Bias for Action: A track record of driving problems to resolution without waiting for permission. You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and making principled calls when the signals are imperfect.
  • Analytical Rigor: Comfort with data. You can define metrics, design and read experiments, and let evidence guide your decisions.
  • Global Operational Readiness: Ability to accommodate flexible working hours for regular early morning syncs with US teams (EST/PST).

title: Project Manager
description:
Who we are

Vaultex are the UK’s leading cash processing company, with sites nationwide. When you join us, you are supporting businesses to run securely and more efficiently, and ensuring continued access to cash for the millions of people that depend on it. To find out more you can visit our website.

Hours: Monday to Friday 09:00 - 17:00 - 35 hours per week

Location: Hybrid role - 1 day per week in Warrington office.

Grade: CM40

Competitive salary available on request.

Job purpose

The Project Manager is responsible for delivering business change and technology infrastructure projects from initiation through to implementation and benefits realisation. The role manages project scope, plans, budgets, resources, risks and stakeholders to ensure agreed outcomes are achieved.

The role works across business and IT teams to support effective delivery of operational change and technical implementation.

Main responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end project delivery using appropriate methodologies, including Prince2, Agile, Waterfall or Hybrid.
  • Maintain project plans, budgets, resource plans, governance documents and progress reporting.
  • Manage scope, dependencies, risks, issues and changes to support delivery on time, within budget and to agreed quality standards.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational requirements and change impacts.
  • Support process improvements, business readiness, communications, training and adoption activities.
  • Monitor benefits realisation and support achievement of business outcomes following implementation.
  • Manage infrastructure projects such as cloud, network, security, workplace technology and platform changes.
  • Coordinate technical teams, suppliers and third-party vendors.
  • Support alignment with architecture, security and operational requirements, including testing, deployment and handover.
  • Maintain project governance, controls and reporting standards.
  • Identify, assess, manage and escalate risks, issues, dependencies and decisions as required.
  • Ensure compliance with organisational policies, security requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Awareness of infrastructure technologies including cloud, networking, cyber security, end-user computing, data centres and Microsoft 365.


Knowledge, skills and experience required.

Essential

  • Project Management qualification, such as PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP or equivalent.
  • Experience delivering business change and technology infrastructure projects.
  • Good understanding of project management methodologies and lifecycle management.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams, stakeholders, suppliers and service providers.
  • Experience delivering projects involving business process change, organisational change, infrastructure refreshes, cloud, network, security or end-user technology deployments.
  • Experience of project governance, risk management and financial management.

Desirable

  • Experience in complex enterprise or regulated environments.
  • Experience delivering digital transformation programmes.
  • Knowledge of ITIL service management principles.
  • Portfolio or programme delivery exposure.
  • Relevant certifications such as AgilePM, Scrum Master, SAFe, Prosci, APMG Change Management, ITIL Foundation or MSP Practitioner.

What we offer you

We are a Living Wage employer with Investors in People Platinum status, and as such have a great range of benefits:

  • A generous company pension – auto-enrolled 4% employee 10% employer.
  • Competitive holiday allowance with an option to purchase additional holidays (varies by grade).
  • Group life assurance 4 x salary.
  • Group income protection.
  • VaulteXtra discounts on retailers, cycle to work, childcare vouchers, gym membership, cash back on purchase, eye tests and many more.
  • Employee Assistance Programme – a free service should our employees require professional and impartial advice for legal advice and counselling.
  • Robust Learning and Development team and opportunities for career progression.
  • Performance based yearly bonus (grade dependant).
  • One day paid volunteering opportunity each year.
  • Mentorship programmes.
  • Access to Peppy - a digital health platform providing support for healthcare in menopause, fertility, men's and women's health.
  • Access to Aviva Digicare+ for annual health checks, nutritional consultations, mental health support, bereavement support and more.
  • Access to Zurich's Virtual GP service.
  • Charles Cameron - free access to independent mortgage advice.

Our culture

Vaultex acknowledges every person’s right to feel valued, respected, and fairly rewarded for what they do. We foster a collaborative environment where everyone is encouraged to share their views and shape Vaultex’s future. We are proud to demonstrate our commitment to transparency and progress as a Work180 endorsed employer. Find out more about our company culture by watching this Video.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace where everyone is supported to be their best. If you're excited about any of our roles but you feel like you don't tick every single box - we still encourage you to apply. You may be the right fit for this role or other roles in our wider team!

Continue the conversation

Vaultex UK Ltd is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all members of the community. We strongly encourage applications from those with disabilities, are culturally & linguistically diverse, are veterans and identify as LGBTQIA+. We value your lived experience and knowledge.

If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process, please let us know.

Upon submitting your application via the Workday link, you will receive an email notifying you of the outcome of your application when this has been reviewed. For successful candidates, the next stage will be a phone interview with the Vaultex recruitment team. If you would like to check the status of your application, please contact a member of the recruitment team.

Due to the secure nature of our business, all successful candidates will need to provide a five-year traceable work history (satisfactory employment references or evidence to explain employment gaps) and complete a criminal record and credit background check. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Earthing & Bonding Engineer
description:
Title:

Senior Earthing & Bonding Engineer

Play a key role in delivering safe, compliant and high‑performance earthing systems across major rail and energy projects.

KBR is seeking an experienced Senior Earthing & Bonding Engineer to join our expanding national Power team. With major project delivery underway across Melbourne’s transport network — including Suburban Rail Loop (SRL) Linewide and Stations and the North West Program Alliance — this role offers the opportunity to shape critical safety systems at the heart of Australia’s future transport and energy infrastructure.

As a Senior Earthing & Bonding Engineer, you will work both autonomously and within multidisciplinary teams to deliver safe earthing, bonding, and lightning protection designs. You will collaborate closely with Primary, Secondary, Structural and Civil teams, ensuring fully integrated and compliant solutions for HV substations, rail systems, and complex transport infrastructure.

You will help support the delivery of earthing and bonding designs in other markets, such as Defence, Maritime, Water and Industrial.

What you’ll be doing

Technical Delivery

  • Deliver detailed earthing and bonding design for HV substations, stations, tunnels and linewide rail systems.

  • Conduct complex earthing studies, including:

  • Soil resistivity modelling

  • Step & touch potential assessments

  • Earthing grid design and optimisation

  • Rail traction return and stray current management

  • CDEGS Modelling

  • Develop designs for lightning protection systems, surge protection and equipotential bonding networks.

  • Produce calculations, earthing layouts, schematics, earthing grid models and installation documentation.

  • Review and interpret utility standards, rail safety requirements, and national electrical codes.

  • Ensure compliance with AS/NZS 3000, AS/NZS 7000, AS 2067, ENA guidelines and project‑specific standards.

  • Carry out site investigation and conduct testing (Soil Resistivity testing, Current Injection Testing etc…) to support design development

Coordination & Collaboration

  • Work closely with Primary, Secondary, Protection, Structural and Civil engineering teams to ensure end‑to‑end design integration.

  • Coordinate with stakeholders, contractors and equipment suppliers across the design and delivery lifecycle.

  • Support design reviews, site assessments, constructability workshops and safety‑in‑design processes.

Leadership & Growth

  • Provide guidance and mentoring to early‑career engineers.

  • Support design checking, QA processes and compliance verification.

  • Contribute to proposals, bid responses, technical methodologies and project strategies.

  • Assist in maturing and standardising national earthing and bonding best practices and tools.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor of Electrical Engineering (Washington Accord accredited or equivalent).

  • Chartered status (CPEng / RPEQ / RPEV) desirable or progressing toward attainment.

  • Proven experience delivering earthing, bonding and lightning protection systems in rail, substations, utilities or major infrastructure.

  • Proficiency in CDEGS / SESShield or similar earthing modelling software.

  • Strong understanding of traction return systems, stray current control and metallic asset bonding.

  • Experience working with DNSPs/TNSPs or rail operators (e.g., MTM, ARTC, Sydney Metro) highly desirable.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple design tasks, priorities and deadlines in fast‑paced project environments.

Why join KBR?

At KBR, we partner with our clients and delivery partners to deliver exceptional outcomes — driven by collaboration, technical excellence and our One Team approach.

With nearly 2,000 employees across Australia, we offer:

  • Access to iconic projects in Transport, Energy and Defence.

  • Genuine opportunities for professional development, certification and career progression.

  • A collaborative, people‑first culture where you are valued and supported.

  • Flexible work arrangements and work/life balance.

  • National career pathways and exposure to multidisciplinary teams.

Join a team where people matter, your expertise is respected, and your work directly shapes critical Australian infrastructure.

KBR Values:

Our KBR Values - We Value Our People, We Deliver, We Are People of Integrity, We Empower, We Are a Team of Teams - embody our people centric organisation.

Our culture, and our genuine focus on our people is a major factor in our success and we want you to be part of our journey.

Help shape tomorrow by applying today!

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to leave your impact on our society with one of Australia’s leading infrastructure businesses. Apply now and follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date with all the latest news and job opportunities.

title: Autolakerer til opstart af ny afdeling i Silkeborg
description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.
Det vigtigste er, at du går op i dit håndværk og afleverer et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Samtidig skal du have lyst til at være en del af en ny afdeling, hvor ikke alt nødvendigvis er fastlagt på forhånd.
Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op sammen med dine nye kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

  • Er uddannet autolakerer og har relevant erfaring
  • Har høj faglig stolthed og sans for kvalitet
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • Er løsningsorienteret og tager ansvar
  • Trives i en travl og ordreproducerende hverdag
  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er fleksibel og klar på de opgaver, der følger med opstarten af en ny afdeling
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden

Vi tilbyder

Du får en særlig mulighed for at komme med helt fra begyndelsen og være med til at sætte dit præg på vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Samtidig bliver du en del af en stor organisation med erfarne kolleger og masser af faglig sparring. Selvom afdelingen er ny, står du derfor ikke alene.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En central rolle i opstarten af en helt ny afdeling
  • Mulighed for at præge arbejdsgange og den daglige drift
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab på tværs af Byens Bilpleje.com
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og godt humør
  • Grundig introduktion til virksomheden og vores processer
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension
  • Mulighed for at vokse med afdelingen i takt med, at forretningen udvikler sig

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kollega.

Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside .

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke ansøgninger via e-mail, og ansøgninger fremsendt på mail vil derfor ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leon Clausen på 22 43 31 76.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Job Overview
GENERAL SUMMARY:
Under the general direction of the Sr. Manager II Information Technology Quality Assurance, the Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) will design, develop, implement, and maintain the automated testing frameworks, test scripts, and tools to ensure the quality and reliability of software applications. SDETs collaborate closely with software developers, data engineers, and other stakeholders to identify test requirements, implement test cases, and integrate automated testing into the software development lifecycle. This role requires a solid understanding of software development principles, proficiency in programming, and scripting languages, expertise in manual testing, and proficiency in test automation tools and methodologies.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

  • Develops and maintains automated test scripts and testing frameworks to verify the functionality, performance, and security of software applications and data repositories using tools such as Java, Selenium WebDriver, Junit, TestNG, Maven and Jenkins.
  • Executes manual and automated test cases, including data validation tests, reports defects, and verifies defect fixes to ensure the overall quality of the software and data. Integrates automated tests, including data validation tests, into the change pipeline to provide rapid feedback on code changes and ensure high-quality software releases and data updates.
  • Manages and generates test data needed for automated testing and data validation while ensuring data consistency and integrity.
  • Works closely with software developers, data engineers and stakeholders to understand application functionality, data processing pipelines, and provide observations on code and data changes to align test scenarios to stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to create test plans, test cases, and test strategies based on product requirements, user stories, and data quality standards.
  • Provides clear and concise test documentation to software developers, data engineers and stakeholders highlighting test results and potential risks.
  • Performs regression testing to verify that software updates or new features do not introduce unexpected issues into the data lake.
  • Investigates and debugs software and data issues while working with development teams and data engineers to resolve them efficiently.
  • May provide mentorship and training to Quality Assurance Engineers, sharing knowledge and best practices.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor\'s degree in a computer-related field, engineering, mathematics, or a related field.
  • Five (5) years of experience as an Automation Software Development Engineer in Test or a similar role, including at least three (3) years of application integration testing and two (2) years of creating automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium with a centralized framework repository
  • Any equivalent combination of education and/or experience may be substituted for the above.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Ability to work in a high-volume demanding IT environment, who is held accountable to meet deadlines for complex projects.
  • Skill in Selenium WebDriver automation frameworks using Java.
  • Skill in programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#, or others) for test automation and data validation, including knowledge of object-oriented programming principles.
  • Ability to prepare and automate functional and regression test scripts with test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Appium).
  • Ability to use version control systems (e.g., Git) and continuous integration tools (e.g., Jenkins, Maven).
  • Skill in data validation tools such as QuerySurge.
  • Knowledge of data lake technology test methodologies.
  • Ability to use tools such as JMeter and LoadRunner for scalable performance testing.
  • Knowledge of integration testing tools such as Postman and SoapUI.
  • Skill in written and oral communication to all levels internal and external to the organization.
  • Skill in defining problems, collecting data, establishing facts, draws valid conclusions, and provides solutions.
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize assignments, and quickly adjust in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Knowledge of software testing methodologies and the testing life cycle.
  • Knowledge of software development processes, agile methodologies, and the SDLC.

Special Requirements

  • Must obtain a Security Identification Display Area (SIDA) Airport Identification/Access Badge (badge) in accordance with Department of Homeland Security Transportation Security Administration (TSA) requirements in Chapter 49 of the Code of Federal Regulations Part 1500 et al., and DFW Airport’s Airport Security Program within thirty (30) days from date of employment and maintain qualification for a SIDA badge upon each badge renewal.
  • Must take Cyber awareness training within thirty (30) days from date of employment.

DESIRABLE

  • Desirable certification in Quality Assurance (e.g., CQE, CSQE, ISTQB or other ASQ certification)
  • Desired experience in solicitation and elicitation of client needs and requirements.
  • Desired experience in web-responsive and native mobile (iOS and Android) testing.
  • Desired experience in the development, implementation, and maintenance of quality systems in an IT environment.
  • Desired experience with administration of Quality Assurance test management tools.

EFFORTS

  • Works in an office environment.
  • Sits for extended periods of time.
  • Uses near-visual acuity in reading written documents and statistical data.
  • Uses keyboard devices and a computer monitor.
  • Uses substantial reasoning abilities in performing analysis and problem solving.
  • Exchanges information by telephone, computer, in writing, and in person.
  • Drives to locations on and off Airport property.

About Us

We are Dallas Fort Worth International (DFW) Airport-one of the most successful airports in the world by any definition. We are recognized for our innovation, leadership, drive for excellence and talented employees.

Our success is made possible because of the diverse talents of over 2,100 employees who champion our mission of providing an exceptional airport experience to our customers and connect our community to the world. We are looking for the best talent to join us and help reimagine what an airport can be.

Bring your talents to DFW. Live and work with purpose.

title: SENIOR SYSTEM DEPLOYMENT ENGINEER
description:
Date Posted:

2026-08-14

Country:

Singapore

Location:

SG-01-SINGAPORE-083 ~ 83 Clemenceau Ave ~ UE SQAURE

Position Role Type:

Onsite

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Senior System Deployment Engineer
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Senior System Deployment to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the deployment, configuration, testing, recovery, and ongoing support of mission-critical airline and airport applications across Windows and Linux environments.

The role covers the complete lifecycle of application infrastructure, including server staging, OS installation, VM provisioning, application deployment, database configuration, high-availability and failover testing, disaster recovery, and production transition.

A key responsibility is providing critical second-level/third-level technical support for major incidents, including the ability to recover and rebuild corrupted virtual machines, operating systems, databases, and application environments from scratch using available backups, recovery media, infrastructure templates, and documented recovery procedures.

The engineer will work across Windows Server, Red Hat Linux, VMware, Hyper-V, AWS Cloud, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Kafka, MongoDB, OpenShift, and related infrastructure technologies, supporting highly available and operationally critical airport systems.

Key Responsibilities
1. Server Staging, Build & Deployment
· Stage, provision, and prepare Windows and Linux servers for application deployment.

· Perform OS installation, hardening, patching, configuration, and baseline validation.

· Deploy and configure airline and airport applications across physical and virtual environments.

· Configure application services, ports, certificates, connectivity, service accounts, and system dependencies.

· Ensure servers meet required performance, security, availability, and operational standards.

· Prepare production, DR, test, FAT, UAT, and staging environments.

2. Critical Incident Support & Infrastructure Recovery
· Provide second-level/third-level technical support for mission-critical airport and airline systems.

· Participate in major incident, problem management, and ITSM processes.

· Troubleshoot critical failures involving servers, VMs, operating systems, databases, applications, storage, and infrastructure services.

· Lead or support full infrastructure recovery when systems become corrupted or unrecoverable.

· Restore and rebuild VMs from scratch, including:

o Recreating virtual machines.

o Reinstalling operating systems.

o Applying required OS configuration and security hardening.

o Restoring application components and services.

o Reconfiguring network, storage, DNS, certificates, and connectivity.

o Restoring application configuration and validating dependencies.

· Recover corrupted or failed servers using available VM backups, snapshots, images, templates, backup repositories, or DR infrastructure.

· Perform complete application environment restoration when the original server/VM cannot be recovered.

· Work with infrastructure, backup, network, database, security, and application teams during major recovery activities.

· Conduct post-recovery validation and ensure systems are returned to operational readiness.

3. Database Recovery & Restoration
· Support SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments supporting mission-critical applications.

· Troubleshoot database corruption, service failures, connectivity issues, performance issues, and abnormal database behavior.

· Perform or coordinate database restoration from backup following database corruption or infrastructure failure.

· Restore databases from full, differential, transaction-log, WAL, or other applicable backup mechanisms.

· Rebuild database servers when required, including:

o OS and VM restoration.

o Database software installation.

o Database configuration.

o Storage and permissions configuration.

o Database restoration.

o User, role, service account, and connectivity configuration.

o Application reconnection and validation.

· Validate database integrity following restoration.

· Support database failover, recovery, replication, and DR testing.

· Coordinate with DBA teams for complex database recovery and corruption scenarios.

· Ensure appropriate RPO/RTO requirements are achieved during recovery.

4. Virtualization & Infrastructure Management
· Manage and troubleshoot VMware and Hyper-V virtual environments.

· Provision, configure, resize, clone, restore, and recover virtual machines.

· Troubleshoot VM, host, datastore, virtual network, resource allocation, and performance issues.

· Perform VM recovery from backup or rebuild VMs from scratch when required.

· Support VMware HA, clustering, snapshots, templates, and DR-related activities.

· Investigate virtualization-related failures affecting critical applications.

· Support data center infrastructure troubleshooting involving compute, storage, virtualization, and server connectivity.

5. High Availability, Failover & Disaster Recovery
· Design, execute, and document server, application, database, and VM failover testing.

· Conduct planned and unplanned failover exercises.

· Validate application recovery following infrastructure or database failures.

· Perform DR restoration and recovery testing.

· Validate RPO and RTO against operational requirements.

· Test recovery procedures for complete server/VM loss and database corruption scenarios.

· Identify recovery gaps and recommend improvements to HA/DR architecture.

· Maintain detailed recovery procedures and runbooks.

6. FAT, UAT & Production Validation
· Plan and execute Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

· Perform technical validation before applications are transitioned into production.

· Validate server, application, database, network, security, and infrastructure dependencies.

· Conduct failover, recovery, performance, and resilience testing.

· Support application cutover and go-live activities.

· Ensure production handover is completed with appropriate documentation and support procedures.

7. Database & Middleware Services
· Configure and support:

o Microsoft SQL Server

o PostgreSQL

o Kafka

o MongoDB

o OpenShift

o Related application middleware and services

· Troubleshoot application-to-database connectivity and service dependencies.

· Support Kafka brokers, topics, connectivity, and service availability.

· Support MongoDB configuration, availability, and recovery activities.

· Work with development and application teams to resolve middleware and database-related incidents.

8. AWS Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure
· Support applications deployed across on-premises data centers and AWS Cloud.

· Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, connectivity, compute, storage, and application dependencies.

· Support VM/server recovery and application restoration in hybrid environments.

· Assist with cloud DR and backup/recovery activities.

· Understand connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and AWS environments.

9. Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Operational Support
· Monitor system health, availability, capacity, and performance.

· Analyze server, application, database, and infrastructure logs.

· Troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk, network, service, database, and application failures.

· Work with monitoring and ITSM tools to identify and resolve recurring incidents.

· Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) and problem management.

· Identify opportunities for automation and proactive monitoring.

10. Scripting & Automation
· Develop scripts and automation to reduce manual deployment and recovery activities.

· Use PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar scripting technologies where appropriate.

· Automate server health checks, service validation, deployment activities, backup validation, and recovery procedures.

· Develop automated health-check and auto-healing capabilities for critical services where feasible.

11. Documentation & Knowledge Management
· Create and maintain:

o Server build documents

o VM configuration documents

o Application deployment procedures

o Database recovery procedures

o VM recovery procedures

o Disaster recovery runbooks

o Failover test procedures

o FAT/UAT test cases

o Troubleshooting guides

o Operational handover documents

· Maintain accurate recovery procedures to enable complete rebuild and restoration from a failed/corrupted environment.

· Ensure documentation is regularly tested and updated following system changes or incidents.

12. Collaboration
· Collaborate with application development, DBA, network, security, cloud, infrastructure, service desk, and operations teams.

· Coordinate with vendors and technology partners during critical incidents.

· Participate in technical reviews, change management, CAB activities, and production implementation.

· Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and operations teams.

Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.

· 8+ years of experience in system deployment, infrastructure support, system recovery, or mission-critical IT environments.

· Strong experience with Windows Server and Red Hat Linux.

· Strong experience in server staging, OS build, configuration, deployment, troubleshooting, and recovery.

· Hands-on experience with VMware and/or Hyper-V.

· Strong experience with VM restoration, rebuilding, and disaster recovery.

· Experience recovering databases and application environments following corruption or infrastructure failure.

· Experience with SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

· Working knowledge of Kafka, MongoDB, and OpenShift.

· Experience with high-availability systems, failover, backup, restore, and DR.

· Experience conducting FAT, UAT, failover, recovery, and production validation testing.

· Working knowledge of AWS Cloud and hybrid infrastructure.

· Experience with ITSM, incident management, change management, and problem management.

· Basic networking knowledge including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewall rules, routing, VLANs, and connectivity troubleshooting.

· Experience with scripting/automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or equivalent.

· Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Red Hat, AWS, or other senior infrastructure certifications are desirable.

· Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Skills
· Prior experience supporting mission-critical airline, airport, transportation, other 24x7 environments.

· Experience supporting systems with strict availability, RTO, and RPO requirements.

· Hands-on experience with complete infrastructure recovery from bare/clean VM or server build through application restoration and production validation.

· Experience with VMware HA, clustering, snapshots, templates, and backup/restore solutions.

Basic network working experience.
Experience in scripting and automation to streamline deployment processes.

description:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Vær med til at sikre stabil drift og moderne softwareleverancer til den danske sundhedssektor

Hos Edora bliver du en del af et nyt tværfagligt udviklings- og driftsteam, der udvikler, drifter og videreudvikler samfundskritiske digitale løsninger til den danske sundhedssektor. Du bliver en del af et projekt med flere udviklingsteams og et samlet budget på over 250 mio. kr., hvor oppetid, sikkerhed og automatisering er afgørende.

Som DevOps Engineer er du med til at skabe fundamentet for stabile og effektive leverancer. Du arbejder tæt sammen med bl.a. Software Developers, Test Automation Engineers og Solution Architects om at automatisere processer, optimere platformen og sikre, at løsningerne kan driftes sikkert og effektivt.

Hvorfor vælge Edora?

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor DevOps er en integreret del af udviklingsprocessen. Du får indflydelse på platform, værktøjer og arbejdsmetoder og bliver en nøgleperson i opbygningen af et nyt team, der udvikler og driver nogle af Danmarks vigtigste digitale sundhedsløsninger.

Du kommer bl.a. til at arbejde med

  • CI/CD-pipelines i Azure DevOps og Jenkins
  • Docker, Ansible og automatiseret deployment
  • Grafana, monitorering og loganalyse
  • Backup-, recovery- og failover-løsninger
  • Drift af samfundskritiske integrationsløsninger
  • Udvikle og vedligeholde CI/CD-pipelines og automatisere build-, test- og releaseprocesser.
  • Automatisere infrastruktur og konfiguration ved hjælp af Infrastructure as Code og Ansible.
  • Implementere monitorering, logning og dashboards, der understøtter hurtig fejlfinding.
  • Bidrage til backup-, recovery- og failover-løsninger samt løbende forbedring af driftsberedskabet.
  • Sikre høj kvalitet og sikkerhed gennem automatisering, sårbarhedshåndtering og compliance.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring med DevOps, automatisering og moderne softwareleverancer.
  • Har arbejdet med CI/CD, Docker, Git og gerne Azure DevOps, Jenkins eller Ansible.
  • Har erfaring med Infrastructure as Code og automatisering af infrastruktur.
  • Har arbejdet med monitorering, loganalyse og værktøjer som Grafana.
  • Har fokus på sikkerhed, stabil drift og løbende forbedringer.
  • Trives i et agilt udviklingsteam og samarbejder tæt med udviklere, testere og arkitekter.
  • Behersker dansk i skrift og tale på et professionelt niveau, da samarbejde, dokumentation og dialog med kunder foregår på dansk.
  • En central rolle i udviklingen og driften af nationale digitale sundhedsløsninger.
  • Mulighed for at præge DevOps-praksis, platform og automatisering i et nyt team.
  • Et fagligt stærkt miljø med dygtige kolleger og stor videndeling.
  • Fleksible rammer, høj grad af tillid og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.
  • Et projekt med stor samfundsmæssig betydning, hvor dit arbejde gør en reel forskel.

Klar til at gøre en forskel?

Stillingen er en fastansættelse med forventet opstart i 4. kvartal 2026 eller 1. kvartal 2027. Er du freelancekonsulent, er du også velkommen til at kontakte os eller tilmelde dig Edoras netværk for freelancekonsulenter via edora.dk/Karriere/Ledige stillinger.

At arbejde hos Edora

Hos Edora udvikler vi digitale løsninger, der understøtter samfundskritiske funktioner. Vi kombinerer høj faglighed med et uformelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, ansvar og udvikling går hånd i hånd. Hos os får du mulighed for at gøre en forskel – både for kunderne, dine kolleger og samfundet.

title: Senior Lead Platform Activation Architect (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Lumen connects the world by helping customers bring people, data, and applications together quickly, securely, and effortlessly. We are building a culture and company from the people up, grounded in teamwork, trust, and transparency — because people power progress. In this role, you will help bring that promise to life by making the Lumen Platform tangible, compelling, and actionable for customers.

The Senior Lead Platform Activation Architect will be a key member of Partner/Product, Readiness, Incubation, Storytelling and Motion (PRISM), Lumen’s outbound, demo-led platform activation team. PRISM partners across Product, Technology, Sales, and the ecosystem to take Lumen Validated Designs and solutions to market through customer-centric narratives, interactive demos, workshops, webinars, and proof-of-value experiences. This is a building role. You do not hand a concept to someone else to make real — you make it real yourself, using AI-assisted development as your primary path from blank page to working demo.

This role bridges the builder-architect and the storyteller: technical enough to architect and build real, working demos, and compelling enough to make a customer feel the outcome. We are looking for a customer-facing technology evangelist who can understand complex solutions, translate them into business outcomes, and confidently tell a compelling story in front of customers, partners, sellers, and decision makers. The ideal candidate brings hands-on build ability and technical fluency, executive presence, curiosity, and creativity with the ability to think from the customer’s point of view and show how Lumen’s platform capabilities solve real business problems.

This role is ideal for someone energized by building something new, shaping go-to-market motions, and helping customers see what is possible with Lumen across cloud, networking, security, AI, partner technologies, and validated design experiences.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Translate Lumen Validated Designs (LVD) into customer-centric activation experiences, including narratives, demos, workshops, webinars, proof-of-value engagements, and field-ready enablement assets.
  • Build and deliver compelling customer stories that lead with business outcomes, buyer personas, and real-world use cases — not just technical features or product capabilities.
  • Design, build, and present interactive demos that make the Lumen Platform tangible for customers and clearly show how solutions work across the full end-to-end architecture.
  • Bring strong stage presence to customer sessions, seller enablement moments, webinars, workshops, and partner-led engagements; confidently facilitate conversations with both technical and business audiences.
  • Partner across Product, Technology, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and ecosystem partners to shape activation strategies, gather field signals, and refine solution narratives based on customer feedback.
  • Help incubate new product-led and partner-led go-to-market motions before they scale, then develop repeatable frameworks, assets, and enablement that allow the field and partner teams to carry the motion forward.
  • Apply the LVD and Demo Center of Excellence framework to ensure demos and activation experiences are validated, interactive, outcome-oriented, and aligned to the customer’s sales moment, decision points, and required level of technical depth.
  • Use modern AI and productivity tools, such as Claude, Copilot, Gemini, or similar platforms, to support storytelling, rapid prototyping, demo creation, research, and scalable enablement. Use AI-assisted development and modern web tooling to get from concept to a working, testable demo in days rather than weeks.
  • Continuously improve activation assets, customer narratives, demo flows, adoption guides, and workshop materials based on customer engagements, seller feedback, and evolving platform capabilities.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8+ years in customer-facing technical or commercial roles such as solution activation, sales engineering, technical pre-sales, technical marketing engineering, developer advocacy, or solutions marketing. Equivalent experience as a hands-on builder in a customer-facing context counts. We care more about what you have built and presented than about the title you built it under.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Proven ability to present to customers, facilitate high-impact conversations, and tell a clear, compelling story that connects technical capabilities to business outcomes.
  • Strong technical fluency with the ability to understand complex platforms, architectures, integrations, and product capabilities and translate them into simple, customer-relevant messaging.
  • Experience personally building, delivering, or contributing to demos, workshops, proof-of-value engagements, webinars, customer briefings, enablement programs, or go-to-market motions at scale.
  • Demonstrated strength in customer empathy, discovery, storytelling, messaging, and outcome-based solution positioning.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across product, engineering, sales, marketing, partner, and field teams with a high degree of ownership, independence, and collaboration.
  • Experience in cloud, product, software, networking, telecom, cybersecurity, AI, partner ecosystems, or large-scale technology environments preferred; telecom and networking experience are a plus, but broad technology/product orientation and customer-facing evangelism are highly valued.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, Copilot, Gemini, or similar platforms preferred.
  • You build with AI, not just about it. You use agentic coding and AI design tooling to go from a blank page to a working, interactive demo in days rather than weeks — prompting, iterating, reading the output well enough to know when it is wrong, and validating it against the real product. You are fluent enough in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to direct and correct what the tools produce.
  • Comfort with hands-on demo creation, rapid prototyping, light coding, front-end concepts, APIs, web technologies, or interactive experience design is preferred; this role does not require deep production engineering ownership but does require enough technical capability to make demos credible and effective.
  • Demonstrated alignment with Lumen’s culture of clarity, courage, customer obsession, growth mindset, respect, teamwork, transparency, trust, and ownership

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

title: Backend Developer
description:
Er du passioneret omkring softwareteknologi og elsker du at skabe løsninger, der gør en reel forskel? Hos Trifork Aarhus leder vi efter en backend udvikler, der vil være med til at bygge fremtidens digitale løsninger – og have det sjovt imens.

Om jobbet og teamet

Som backend udvikler ved Trifork, vil du blive en del af et agilt og meget talentfuldt udviklingsteam, hvor det faglige niveau er i top. Du vil få mulighed for at arbejde på innovative og varierede løsninger – fra etablerede virksomheder til spændende startups – hvor din faglighed virkelig kommer i spil. Det er derfor vigtigt at du er nysgerrig og trives med nye udfordringer. Du vil primært komme til at arbejde med .NET og Azure men i forskellige former og afskygninger, og du vil have mulighed for at påvirke løsningerne med din faglighed.

Vi ansætter ikke blot til en stilling – vi leder efter passionerede mennesker med teknisk flair og nysgerrighed. Du er et softwaretalent og har allerede arbejdet med software i flere år med succes. Hos Trifork tilbyder vi dig en fantastisk arbejdsplads med plads til udvikling i en uformel og faglig stærk arbejdskultur og et godt socialt fællesskab.

Du vil typisk komme til at arbejde på løsninger hvor du er ansvarlig for opsamling, processering og udstilling af data for at automatisere processer, lette arbejdsgange og informere brugere, operatører og virksomhedsejere til at tage vigtige beslutninger. Du vil komme til at arbejde i selvkørende teams med både backend og frontend udviklere, UX'ere og andre roller.

Om dig

Du brænder for softwareteknologi og er nysgerrig efter ny viden. Du har praktisk erfaring med backend udvikling og har sikkert haft hænderne i flere løsninger og systemer af varierende størrelse. Du går op i dit håndværk og har sunde principper omkring din softwareudvikling. Du er en teamplayer som værdsætter integritet og ærlighed. Du er ikke fristet af "den hurtige løsning" men ved den eksisterer og forstår at tænke både arkitektur og design ind i et løsningsforslag.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er softwareingeniør, datalog eller lignende, men det vigtigste er dig og din erfaring. Du udvikler aktivt din viden og flytter løbende dit faglige niveau. Du er god til at drive dig selv, er opsøgende og ikke bange for at tale med og besøge brugere og kunder. AI er en naturlig del af din værktøjskasse og du bruger aktivt energi på hele tiden at tilpasse den måder du arbejder på så du får størst mulig værdi af AI.

Du vil indgå i et team med både nye og erfarne udviklere, hvor vi arbejder med spændende løsninger indenfor Cloud, Microservices, Docker og K8s, Serverless, IoT Systemer, Web og Mobile apps, Machine Learning og meget andet. Miljøet er ofte Azure Cloud og .NET/C#, men vi er ikke låst til én Cloud Provider eller ét programmeringssprog.

Selvom du primært er backend udvikler, har du et full stack mindset, som gør at du ikke er bange for at påtage dig og kaste dig ud i opgaver hvor teknologistakken er ny for dig – naturligvis under hensynstagen til at du har mindre erfaring på dette område.

Hos os får du ikke blot et job, men en mulighed for at vokse – både som udvikler og som menneske.

Vi forventer, at du har

  • 2-4 år programmeringserfaring - gerne .NET/C#
  • Erfaring med integration mellem systemer via API'er og strukturerede protokoller, SQL/no SQL databaser, forskellige arkitektoniske mønstre (fx event driven)
  • Interesse indenfor DevOps/GitOps og opsætning af professionelle udviklingsmiljøer med automatisk test og deployment
  • Teknisk nysgerrig og brænder for teknologiske udfordringer
  • Stor ansvarsfølelse og lyst til at bidrage både fagligt og socialt
  • Har adopteret AI som en fast del af din værktøjskasse

Hvad vi tilbyder

Vores daglige arbejde er karakteriseret af en åben og ærlig atmosfære, og vi sætter fokus på at skabe et fagligt udfordrende men også sjovt arbejdsmiljø. Vi dyrker både faglighed og fællesskab – med regelmæssige tech-demos, interne hackathons, sociale events og ikke mindst et fællesskab, hvor alle løfter i flok.

Vi arbejder i agile multifunktionelle teams med et fokus på ansvarlighed og tæt samarbejde med vores kunder. Professionel sparring er vigtigt for os, og derfor bestræber vi os på, at du altid har en kollega med på dine opgaver, ligesom du til at begynde med vil være tilknyttet en mentor.

Ingen konsulenter, men en betroet teknologisk partner

I Trifork har vi ikke en klassisk konsulentmodel, hvor vi ansætter dig og sender dig alene til kundens adresse. Vi positionerer os selv hos vores kunder som en betroet teknologisk partner, og i det daglige vil arbejdet typisk foregå i en kombination af on-site hos kunden, fra vores egne kontore samt hjemmearbejdsdage.

Ikke mere end 42 mennesker på kontoret

Hvorfor, spørger du så?

Vi ønsker at sikre at et kontor ikke bliver for stort, så du altid ved hvem du sidder ved siden af. Ved ikke at have for store kontorer, sikrer vi at have en uformel og afslappende kultur, hvor alle kender hinanden. Trifork føles som at arbejde i en lille virksomhed men samtidig ved du, at du kan trække på folk fra andre kontorer. Det skaber et stærkt og samarbejdsvenligt miljø, hvor teams, der arbejder på forskellige løsninger, deler viden med hinanden.

Derudover tilbyder vi

  • Trifork Hackerdays – et par gange om året tager vi væk fra vores kontor, for at dykke ned nye og spændende teknologier og løsninger
  • Uformelt arbejdsmiljø og højt humør
  • Scrum Certificering
  • Lækker frokostordning i vores kantine samt bredt udvalg af snacks, drikkevarer og friskværnet italiensk kaffe
  • Macbook Pro eller high-end PC, og telefon efter eget valg
  • Mulighed for at forme din rolle og tage ansvar i en virksomhed i vækst

title: Smals - Test Automation Engineer
description:
Uw rol

  • Als Test Automation Engineer ondersteun je ontwikkelteams door het opzetten en onderhouden van test automation frameworks en test scripts.
  • Je creeërt en beheert testscripts voor functionele, regressie- en performantietesten. Je ontwikkelt een testplan en staat garant voor de kwaliteit in je testopdracht.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de geautomatiseerde testen naadloos worden geïntegreerd in de Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, zodat nieuwe software-updates continu en betrouwbaar kunnen worden getest.
  • Het analyseren van testresultaten is een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk. Je beoordeelt de testuitkomsten nauwkeurig en je rapporteert je bevindingen aan het ontwikkelingsteam. Hierdoor kunnen eventuele problemen snel worden geïdentificeerd en opgelost, wat bijdraagt aan de stabiliteit en kwaliteit van de software.
  • Daarnaast werk je intensief samen met ontwikkelaars, QA-specialisten en andere belanghebbenden. Door gezamenlijk teststrategieën te verbeteren en best practices toe te passen, zorg je ervoor dat de softwareproducten voldoen aan hoge kwaliteitsnormen en optimaal presteren.

Uw profiel

  • Je behaalde een bachelor in de informatica of een gelijkwaardige expertise. Je hebt eveneens een eerste ervaring in het testdomein.
  • Je voert geautomatiseerde testen uit op SOAP & REST-services en hebt ervaring met Java en SQL. Je werkt met tools zoals Selenium, Cucumber en Postman en bij voorkeur ook met JUnit, Lombok, XML en IDE's. Ervaring met versiebeheer is een troef.
  • Verder ben je vertrouwd met het werken in een Agile omgeving en volgens Agile methodologie.
  • Tevens heb je een goede kennis van cloud platforms.
  • Je certificering in ISTQB Foundation en ISTQB Certified Test Automation Engineer is een uitgesproken troef.
  • Je beschikt over een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen en weet technische uitdagingen snel en doeltreffend te analyseren en op te lossen.
  • Dankzij je analytisch denkvermogen ben je in staat softwaregedrag en testresultaten grondig te evalueren en hieruit waardevolle inzichten te halen.
  • Daarnaast heb je goede communicatieve vaardigheden. Zo weet je effectief te communiceren met je verschillende belanghebbenden binnen een project.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van het Frans en het Engels.

Ons aanbod

  • Je krijgt een gevarieerde, uitdagende en maatschappelijk relevante job waarbij je bijdraagt aan IT-oplossingen die een belangrijke rol spelen in de samenleving. Onze slogan 'ICT for society' weerspiegelt dit perfect.
  • Zoek je een goede balans tussen werk en privéleven? Geniet van flexibele werkuren en maak gebruik van ons zeer uitgebreid telewerkbeleid.
  • We bieden ruime interne en externe opleidingsmogelijkheden, waardoor je je technische skills en persoonlijke vaardigheden voortdurend kunt aanscherpen.
  • We bieden je een competitief salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen zoals hospitalisatieverzekering, aanvullend pensioenplan, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques,...
  • IT-functies kunnen rekenen op een mobiliteitsbudget met de keuze voor een bedrijfswagen en/of terugbetaling openbaar vervoer. Onder bepaalde voorwaarden kan je dit budget zelfs gebruiken voor de betaling van je huur of hypothecaire lening.
  • Via ons 'Benefits at Work'-platform geniet je van mooie kortingen op mode, elektronica, daguitstappen, vakantieverblijven, ...
  • We voeren een gelijkekansenbeleid en vinden o.a. equal pay belangrijk.

description:
