title: Sr. Subcontracts Administrator
description:
Title:

Sr. Subcontracts Administrator

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR! - At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

Program Summary

KBR Government Solutions delivers full life cycle professional and technical solutions that improve operational readiness and drive innovation. Our solutions help ensure mission success on land, air, sea, space and cyberspace for the Department of Defense, intelligence community, NASA, and other federal agencies. KBR’s areas of expertise include engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity.

Job Summary

KBR is seeking a highly motivated Senior Subcontracts Administrator to oversee and perform a full range of subcontract administration activities associated with subcontracting work. This includes qualifying suppliers, issuing requests for proposals, evaluating proposals, and maintaining subcontract files in accordance with established procedures. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing subcontracting work as assigned on multiple projects and ensuring the seamless integration of subcontract work within the broader program including cost, schedule, technical, and quality management.

Under broad direction of the Sr. Subcontracts Administrator will be accountable for managing the delivery of Subcontracts objectives of the assigned Projects/Programs.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Drive all aspects of major subcontract execution including cost, schedule, technical, and quality performance, ensuring full integration of subcontract work within the program (e.g., proposals, negotiations, contract execution).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the subcontractor and project management team, remaining accountable to Subcontracts and Supply Chain leadership.
  • Oversee the entire procurement cycle, coordinating between KBR’s technical team and suppliers across various functional teams.
  • Address critical, time-sensitive, and complex issues including proposal evaluations, contract documentation, and modifications for contract changes.
  • Assist in developing subcontract specifications, work statements, and terms and conditions for specialized materials, equipment, and services.
  • Lead key supplier negotiations regarding cost, terms and conditions, and long-term agreements.
  • Control costs, manage cost avoidance, and perform price analysis as required.
  • Develop supplier sourcing strategies and metrics (scorecards) for all commodity products.
  • Measure, manage, and improve vendor delivery performance.
  • Research market trends to maintain a world-class procurement environment.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis as requested by upper management and corporate supply chain leadership.
  • Implement initiatives to improve efficiency and sustain KPIs.
  • Implement GR/IR strategies to promote timely payment to suppliers.
  • Provides procurement support to business development team for proposal efforts.

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree a plus.
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in procurement and subcontract management.
  • Minimum of 6 - 8 years of subcontracts management experience negotiating Master Service Agreements and complex Subcontract Agreements.
  • Proven experience in establishing scope of work and writing technical or non-technical documentation including strong understanding of Specifications, Statements of Work, Contracts/Subcontracts, and Supplier Deliverables.
  • Experience supporting all subcontract types (IDIQ, Cost Reimbursable, Fixed Price, etc.), negotiations, terms and conditions, incentive arrangements, and order placement.
  • Strong working knowledge of FAR (Federal Acquisition Regulation) and DFAR (Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement).
  • Experience in US Government and Commercial contracts is desirable.
  • Significant experience working with and/or leading audits with DCMA, including CPSR Audits, is highly preferred.
  • Strong background with Cost Analysis and Price Analysis.
  • Strong Negotiation Skills.
  • Proven experience managing complex Subcontract Agreements and Master Service Agreements.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written, verbal, and presentation to effectively communicate business cases to all levels of peers, suppliers, and management.
  • Ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels including with international teams and suppliers.
  • Strong project management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to solve complex problems with excellent organizational skills.
  • Background Check Required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in US Government and Commercial contracts is desirable.
  • Experience providing proposals support is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in developing and tracking internal metrics.
  • Desire to work in a collaborative environment as a part of a diverse team.
  • Strong ability to implement GR/IR strategies to promote on-time payment to suppliers.
  • In-depth understanding of global procurement processes and supply chain management.
  • Ability to drive initiatives to improve efficiency and sustain KPIs.

KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

title: Director AI Engineering
description:
MinterEllison is moving from experimentation to enterprise delivery. We've proven that AI can create value. The challenge now is building the engineering capability, platforms and standards that turn promising ideas into secure, trusted and scalable solutions across a highly regulated, high trust environment. We're seeking an exceptional technology leader to establish and lead our AI Engineering function and Centre of AI Enablement. This is a rare opportunity to shape how AI is engineered, governed and deployed across one of Australia's largest professional services organisations.

The opportunity

Reporting to our Chief AI Officer, you will build and lead the engineering discipline that sits behind MinterEllison's AI strategy.

You will create the platforms, architectures, reusable services, standards and guardrails that enable AI solutions to move from prototype to production and be adopted safely at scale. Importantly, this is not a role focused on delivering individual AI projects.

You will build the pathway that allows teams across the firm to innovate confidently, while ensuring security, governance, quality and responsible AI practices are embedded by design. As a key member of our AI leadership team, you will play a critical role in defining the future of AI across the firmby collaborating closely with Managing Partner of AI and Directors of Technology acrossthe firm.

What you'll do Build enterprise AI capability
  • Define and lead the firm's AI engineering strategy, standards and technical direction
  • Establish a production-grade AI engineering capability that can reliably scale AI solutions
  • Build and lead a high-performing team of AI engineers and platform specialists
Create the platform for AI delivery
  • Own the AI platform architecture, including model management, orchestration, retrieval services, evaluation frameworks and reusable components by working closely with key Digital leaders including CISO and Directors of Infrastructure and Technology.
  • Define engineering patterns that enable AI to be embedded across enterprise and legal technology platforms
  • Lead decisions on AI tools, models, platforms and strategic technology partnerships
Lead the Centre of AI Enablement
  • Create a Centre that empowers teams to build by best practices rather than building everything centrally
  • Develop reference architectures, frameworks, guardrails and reusable assets
  • Establish self-service capabilities that accelerate adoption across the business
  • Build evaluation, monitoring and observability capabilities that ensure AI solutions remain accurate, reliable and secure
  • Embed responsible AI principles directly into engineering controls and workflows
  • Partner with Cyber Security, Risk, Governance and Technology leaders to ensure robust safeguards are built into every solution
Enable the future of agentic AI
  • Develop the foundations required for trusted AI agents, including orchestration, governance, security and identity management
  • Help shape the firm's future AI architecture and operating model
About you

You are an AI engineering leader who has moved beyond proof-of-concepts and pilots. You have built production AI systems that people depend on and understand what it takes to operate them safely and reliably at enterprise scale. You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, strategy with executives and governance with risk leaders.Collaboration is key to the success of this role.

You'll likely bring:

  • Significant experience leading software engineering, AI engineering or machine learning teams
  • A track record of taking generative AI solutions from concept through to supported production
  • Experience building platforms, developer enablement functions or shared engineering capabilities
  • Deep understanding of modern AI architectures, including LLMs, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks and AI lifecycle operations
  • Experience establishing engineering standards, governance frameworks and operational excellence practices
  • Strong stakeholder leadership across technology, data, security, risk and business functions
  • Experience in regulated or high-trust environments such as professional services, financial services, government, healthcare or similar

This is an opportunity to build something foundational. You'll join at a pivotal moment as the firm invests in the next phase of its AI journey. Rather than inheriting a mature function, you'll have the mandate to create the platform, operating model, team and standards that will define how AI is delivered across the organisation for years to come. You'll work alongside senior leaders who recognise the strategic importance of AI and are committed to building trusted, scalable and responsible capabilities that create lasting value for our people and clients.

title: Environmental Senior Project Manager

At Woodard & Curran, there’s nothing we love more than a tough environmental engineering challenge. We handle a wide range of water and environmental issues—solving complex problems with creativity and tenacity. That’s how we make a difference to our clients, people, and planet. Our company was founded on a simple concept: provide a safe and enjoyable place to work with opportunity, integrity, and commitment, and we will attract talented people. Those people are at the heart of our firm, solving some of the most pressing water and environmental challenges for our clients.

What’s in it for you:

Woodard & Curran is offering a unique opportunity to join our remediation team, which provides high-quality permitting, compliance, assessment, remediation, and construction services to a variety of private sector clients including railway clients across the nation. You will manage complex environmental projects including those involving the evaluation and management of PCB-containing materials that improve our environment and benefit our communities. Our client managers, technical leaders, and team of talented engineers and scientists will help you provide exceptional service to our clients. You will be an active participant in our delivery system improvement programs and continuous learning opportunities.

Who are we looking for:

Woodard & Curran has an opportunity for a Senior Project Manager to join our growing firm and provide high-quality consulting services to our industrial, commercial, and railway clients. The selected candidate will be a key member of our national Remediation Practice and work directly with a diverse and talented group of engineers and scientists at the firm. The ideal candidate is a current Senior Project Manager with strong technical experience delivering high-quality compliance and remediation services, specifically to railroad industry clients located across the firm’s geography and core markets. In addition, the ideal candidate will be sought out by clients for innovative solutions, support and conduct business development efforts, and keep abreast of critical client and industry regulations and issues. The successful candidate will be an energetic, motivated, growth-oriented professional who can work independently and lead multi-disciplined project teams.

Offering Flexible Remote Schedule

This virtual work schedule will support clients in the following locations: Nationwide but primarily in the Northeast and Midwest.

Travel up to 25%: Primarily local travel is required.

What will you be doing at Woodard & Curran?

    • Responsibilities include maintaining and establishing relationships with clients to procure and manage the scope, schedule, budget, and delivery of permitting, compliance, remediation and construction projects.
    • Work directly with clients and a team to lead the delivery of projects related to providing technical advice, planning, design, permitting, and construction phase services for these projects.
    • Frequent interaction with clients, potential clients, owners and regulators. Business development efforts will include preparation of proposals, project interviews and marketing activities.
    • Manage and supervise the projects developed utilizing Woodard & Curran technical and administrative staff.
    • Lead and complete technical tasks as required to support the projects. Emergency response opportunities are also a possibility.
    • Specific experience and focus areas include developing site investigation plans, evaluating remediation alternatives, reviewing construction plans and related documentation and reporting in accordance with applicable environmental laws and regulations.
    • Work also involves the selection, coordination, and management of subcontractors, cost estimating, and management of the scope, schedule, and budget for various project tasks.
    • Report writing and interaction with project staff, clients and regulatory agencies will also play an important role in the candidate’s success

What You Will Need To Succeed:

    • A total of 15 to 20 plus years of professional experience with an environmental/engineering consulting firm.
    • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in environmental science or environmental engineering from an accredited program.
    • Experience working with railroad clients.
    • Strong appreciation of and commitment to safe work practices is mandatory.
    • Client focused with an entrepreneurial spirit.
    • Demonstrated experience with scoping, budgeting and implementation of complex permitting and compliance programs.
    • Familiarity with railroad regulatory programs across northeastern and midwestern states.
    • Ability to work independently and on large multi-disciplinary teams.
    • Outstanding written and verbal skills.
    • Demonstrated leadership and ability to mentor and develop a project team.
    • OSHA HAZWOPER 40-hour and Railway Worker safety training a plus

description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron is a global leader in DRAM technology, driving innovation that enables the next generation of computing, artificial intelligence, and data-driven applications. The DRAM Technology Development organization focuses on advancing semiconductor manufacturing capabilities through collaborative research, process innovation, and technology scaling. Team members work across multiple engineering fields to develop breakthrough memory solutions that shape the future of the industry.
As a Process Integration Engineer, you will contribute to the development of next-generation DRAM technologies by collaborating with process, materials, device, and design engineering teams. This role is responsible for coordinating module-related development activities, defining technical requirements, resolving complex integration challenges, and supporting the successful execution of technology development programs. Responsibilities

title: Program Manager II, Energy
description:
About Us

Every moment of every day, people all over the world rely on the infrastructure work provided by Quanta Services and Quanta Government Solutions (QGS). With its highly skilled and innovative workforce, Quanta is the largest specialty contractor in North America that powers modern life. Find your future with us by being a part of something bigger – leading the energy transition in building a better world for generations to come.

Imagine what you could do here. We encourage and inspire our people to embrace opportunities within our corporate office and 200 operating companies providing solutions for the utility, renewable energy, electric power, industrial, communications and government industries worldwide.

Quanta’s culture is about creating an environment where all employees can be themselves, are valued, and have an equal opportunity to succeed. When you join our team, you join a dynamic culture in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is valued.

About this Role

COMPANY: Quanta Government Solutions

JOB TITLE: Program Manager II, Energy

DEPARTMENT: Operations, Energy

MATRIX INTERFACES: Construction Operations, Safety & Quality, Finance, HR, IT/Cyber, Legal & Compliance, Contracts, Supply Chain, Preconstruction, Project Management Office (PMO)

LOCATION: Remote, United States – supporting multiple QGS project sites as business needs require

REPORTS TO: Program Director, Energy

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Quanta Government Solutions (QGS) is the federal infrastructure delivery platform of Quanta Services, a Fortune 500 company, delivering complex infrastructure solutions for U.S. Government customers. The Energy vertical supports the Department of Energy including federal energy, environmental, and national security programs through disciplined program management, operational excellence, and strong customer partnerships.

This position will initially serve as a roving Program Manager, supporting multiple QGS Energy project sites and programs based on operational need. As the Energy portfolio grows, the role may transition to primary support of a single site or program once sufficient workload exists to warrant dedicated assignment.

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager II to lead a portfolio of federal energy and infrastructure programs while providing guidance and mentorship to Program Manager I staff. This role is responsible for successful program execution, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and regulatory compliance across multiple concurrent programs. Serving as the operational bridge between day-to-day program execution and the strategic direction established by the Senior Program Manager and the Program Director, the Program Manager II drives disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and consistent delivery while supporting the long-term growth of the Energy portfolio.

What You'll Do

  • Program Leadership: Lead and support a portfolio of federal energy and infrastructure programs across multiple QGS project sites, ensuring successful execution of program objectives, customer requirements, scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety. Prioritize resources and attention across assigned locations based on business and operational needs.
  • PMO Alignment: Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) to implement program governance, reporting requirements, delivery standards, and best practices across assigned programs. Ensure program execution aligns with organizational objectives, customer expectations, and established program management processes.
  • Process Improvement: Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, strengthen program execution, improve customer satisfaction, and promote standardized program management practices across assigned programs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Construction Operations, Safety & Quality, Finance, HR, IT/Cyber, Legal & Compliance, Contracts, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to coordinate resources, resolve issues, remove barriers, and ensure successful delivery of assigned programs. Partner with site leadership and cross-functional teams across multiple locations to coordinate resources, resolve issues, remove barriers, and ensure consistent program execution.
  • Change Management: Support the implementation of organizational and program-level change initiatives by coordinating communication, process adoption, resource planning, and execution activities that promote successful program outcomes and continuous improvement.
  • Risk & Compliance Management: Proactively identify, evaluate, and resolve program risks, contractual requirements, operational issues, and schedule impacts. Develop mitigation strategies, implement corrective actions, and escalate significant concerns to the Senior Program Manager as appropriate.
  • Performance Management & Reporting: Prepare and present program performance reports, financial forecasts, customer updates, and operational metrics that provide visibility into program health, project status, financial performance, and key business objectives. Support proposal development, contract administration, and business planning activities as assigned.

What You'll Bring

Required Education and Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in Program Management, Project Management, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field supporting federal programs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Public Administration, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent programs while managing financial performance, schedules, and customer expectations.
  • Experience working within or alongside a Project Management Office (PMO), including program governance and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of federal contracting, project delivery, regulatory compliance, and program management principles.
  • Experience collaborating within complex matrix organizations and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Strong leadership, communication, organizational, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience supporting customer relationships within federal energy, infrastructure, engineering, or construction environments.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management software such as Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience supporting federal energy, environmental, infrastructure, engineering, or national security programs.
  • Familiarity with Department of Energy (DOE), National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), or other federal government customers.
  • Experience mentoring project or program management professionals.
  • Experience supporting proposal development, business development, or capture activities.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or willingness to obtain certification within 12 months of hire.

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

Required Licenses/Certifications

  • None required for this position.

Preferred Licenses/Certifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar industry-recognized certification.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance as required by assigned programs.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • This position has no formal direct supervisory responsibilities but provides day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentorship to Program Manager I staff. The Program Manager II promotes consistent program management practices, supports professional development, and serves as a resource for cross-functional teams while ensuring successful execution of assigned programs.

description:
We are seeking passionate and skilled professionals to join our team in building a next-generation cloud-based data platform for one of the largest telecommunications companies in Hong Kong. Candidates will play a key role in data solution development, analytics enablement, and business insights delivery, collaborating closely with Data Scientists, BI Analysts, and cross-functional stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines ingesting and transforming large volumes of data into Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Develop and optimize data marts and data warehouse structures to support Business Intelligence (BI) and analytical workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and data preparation for advanced analytics and machine learning models.
  • Implement software components following architectural standards, security practices, and coding guidelines.
  • Conduct unit testing, support system and user acceptance testing, and assist with production implementation.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for systems, operations, and data flows.
  • Provide ongoing user and application support, ensuring reliability and performance of production data environments.

Business Analysis & Data Governance

  • Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications, working closely with business units and IT teams.
  • Perform data analysis, gap assessments, and process mapping to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and analytical frameworks supporting business decision-making.
  • Support and execute data governance initiatives, including metadata management, data quality monitoring, and compliance alignment.
  • Facilitate effective communication between business and technical teams, ensuring alignment on objectives, priorities, and deliverables.
  • Lead and manage data engineering projects across diverse industry sectors (Public, Enterprise, BFSI).
  • Drive project planning and execution for data pipeline and data management initiatives.
  • Mentor and guide junior data engineers and analysts to achieve project and professional goals.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure project deliverables meet business, technical, and compliance requirements.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or related disciplines.
  • Data Engineer: Minimum 3 years of experience in data engineering, data warehouse, or BI development.
  • Senior Data Engineer / Business Analyst: Minimum 5 years of experience with proven technical delivery and stakeholder-facing experience.
  • Hands-on experience in data warehouse/lake design, ETL development, and cloud data platforms (preferably GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, and other relevant programming or scripting languages.
  • Good understanding of RDBMS, NoSQL, and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or Looker).
  • Familiarity with Big Data frameworks, Cloud-native technologies, and Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) platforms is a strong advantage.
  • Demonstrated analytical thinking with the ability to interpret complex business problems and convert them into actionable data solutions.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills; fluent in English and Chinese (spoken and written).
  • Project management experience or certifications (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP, or Scrum Master) are advantageous but not essential.

Ideal Candidate Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with attention to data quality and integrity.
  • Collaborative team player with a proactive \"can-do\" attitude.
  • Fast learner who embraces new technologies and continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-paced environments under agile methodologies.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Events (IRL)
description:
Our Mission

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.


Our Values

  • Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
  • Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
  • Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
  • Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
  • Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
  • Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

The Role:

At Tinder we're investing in a new way for our users to spark something new with someone new: IRL events. Events break the dating app paradigm of swipe, match, chat– introducing discovery anchored to real-world experiences, surfacing the coolest events and places in every city with the ability to connect with who’s in the room before, during, and after.

As Senior TPM, you will own the cross-functional operating model for this fast-paced team, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, BD, Partnerships, Event Ops, and Marketing leadership to bring clarity to ambiguity, structure to rapidly evolving plans and priorities, and deliver incredible user experiences at global scale.

Where You'll Work:

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in Los Angeles, CA.

In this role, you will:
  • Own end-to-end delivery of the Events product roadmap, including in-app features and operational tooling (event management and publishing), tracking milestones, aligning dependencies, and mitigating risks across mobile, backend, and web engineering teams.
  • Act as the connective tissue across Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, BD, and Event Operations leads to drive cross-functional alignment on the product roadmap and major launches (new markets, new partners, new product experiences), developing and overseeing project timelines to ensure on time delivery.
  • Define the operating model for the Events program, determining what rhythms, artifacts, and checkpoints teams actually need as the product scales.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues by coordinating with teams to determine solutions and prioritize tasks, while maintaining a high bar for both quality and velocity.
  • Provide clear, timely communications to the executive and senior leadership team on program health, including translating technical tradeoffs and delivery risks into recommendations that shape decisions, not just status updates.

You'll need:
  • 6+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, preferably supporting a live events, marketplace, event aggregation, ticketing, or two-sided supply-and-demand product.
  • Demonstrated success in partnering with both product/engineering teams and business teams (partnerships, BD, marketing), cultivating strong cross-functional relationships and influencing outcomes in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • An ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information, an entrepreneurial mindset, and persistent execution.
  • Proven ability to distill complex requirements from multiple stakeholders into actionable project plans. Experience building delivery plans, dependency maps, and risk registers for programs spanning multiple engineering platforms.
  • Proven ability to define and stand up an operating model for a 0-to-1 or rapidly scaling program, not just execute one that already exists.
  • Expert-level proficiency managing cross-functional projects using collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Google Suite, and Figma.
  • Strong track record managing multi-market or multi-region launches.
  • Expertise in agile methodologies and a deep understanding of software development best practices.

$ 160000- $175000 a year
The salary range for this position is $160,000 - $175,000. Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Los Angeles, CA. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.

As a full-time employee, you’ll enjoy:

  • Investment in your development: mentorship through our MentorMatch program, access to 6,000+ online courses through Udemy, and an annual $3,000 stipend for your professional development

  • Investment in your wellness: access to mental health support via Modern Health, paid concierge medical membership, pet insurance, fitness membership subsidy, and commuter subsidy

  • Free subscription to Tinder Gold


Commitment to Inclusion
At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. title: Application Security Manager
description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent, our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

You will build the security layer for how Workleap writes software, and then you will teach it to run itself.

Today that means the traditional stack done properly. SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret scanning wired into GitHub Actions so findings land where developers already work, with the noise tuned out rather than tolerated. Threat modeling on architectural changes. Vulnerability intake and triage that closes the loop instead of filling a backlog.

Where it goes next is the actual reason this role exists. We are moving toward agentic security review, where agents perform the first pass on every pull request, reason about the change in context, and escalate what matters to a human. Nobody has fully solved this. Rules engines miss intent, models hallucinate findings, and the gap between the two is where the interesting work is. You will close that gap, and you will decide how much trust the system earns at each step.

You will be a hands on individual contributor. You will write the code.

Your impact:

  • Build the security guardrails for AI assisted and agentic development so speed and safety stop being a tradeoff
  • Move security review from human bottleneck to automated first pass with human judgment reserved for what is genuinely ambiguous
  • Achieve near-zero developer friction on security signals by wiring SAST/DAST/SCA into CI/CD with noise tuned low enough that findings actually get fixed.
  • Lead threat modeling on new features and architectural changes
  • Drive real remediation of application security vulnerabilities, measured by risk retired and not tickets closed
  • Harden Azure environments and deployment patterns alongside Infrastructure SecOps

Your team

You will join LeapSec and report to the Director of Infrastructure and Security. We're a small team with broad reach covering product security, cloud security, and governance across Workleap and ShareGate. That means your work ships, you own it end to end, and you set the priorities that matter. The scope is real, and so is the autonomy that comes with it.

You will partner closely with the AI SDLC team, which builds the internal platform that lets AI agents operate across the development lifecycle, and with product engineering across the organization.

What you'll bring

  • Five or more years in application security, DevSecOps, or security focused software development, with a real engineering background behind it
  • Deep working knowledge of web application security, OWASP Top 10, and CWE Top 25
  • Proven experience building security automation into CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions preferred
  • Built and shipped real agent tooling, not just used it. MCP servers, Claude skills, subagents, and custom tools that other people depend on
  • Context engineering as a discipline. Knowing what an agent needs in front of it to reason correctly about a codebase, and what to leave out
  • Understanding of the security model of agentic systems themselves. Prompt injection, tool permission scoping, credential handling in agent workflows, and what an agent with repo write access can do when it is wrong
  • Proficiency in Python for building tooling, not just scripting around it
  • Hands on experience with AI assisted and agentic development workflows and a clear view of where they break
  • Solid grasp of Azure services, infrastructure security, and deployment patterns
  • The ability to explain a risk tradeoff to an engineer and to an executive in the same week and be understood by both

Strong assets

  • Secure code review experience in C#/.NET
  • Experience integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret scanning at scale
  • Familiarity with OIDC, SAML, and OAuth
  • Exposure to SOC2 requirements
  • Experience running vulnerability discovery and triage with a developer community

What the job comes with

  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gathering twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

title: Software Developer
description:
We are seeking a proactive Software Developer who demonstrates a strong passion and proven experience in scientific and geospatial data engineering. Your initial focus will be on the next generation of shared data foundations that underpin DHI's scientific software ecosystem across our products and advisory work: the components that move scientific and geospatial data efficiently between our simulation engines, desktop applications, GIS software, and the scientific Python ecosystem. This work reflects DHI's strong commitment to open standards and interoperability. At a later stage you will also contribute to broader development across DHI's software portfolio.

Based in Hørsholm, Denmark, you will be part of a global development team focused on developing our MIKE product suite, which is used worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop essential core and common components for handling structured grids, unstructured meshes, time series, and raster and vector geospatial data, and for moving these efficiently between DHI's products, GIS tools, and the scientific Python ecosystem
  • Transform legacy code to modern tech stacks
  • General development across DHI’s software portfolio and shared components
  • Write production code backed by unit tests and automated checks
  • Work together with developers, project managers, product owners and other colleagues

You possess some of these professional qualifications:

  • Experience with both C++ and C#
  • Experience with desktop application development for Windows and Linux
  • Experience with geospatial data (vector and raster) and interoperability with GIS software
  • Experience with Python and the scientific Python ecosystem (e.g. NumPy, xarray); awareness of open standards in the scientific data community is a plus
  • Experience with AI-guided development
  • Experience with scientific software and mathematics-based programming
  • Experience with performance-aware I/O and data handling for large datasets, including formats such as Zarr and netCDF (chunking, lazy evaluation, efficient subsetting)
  • Experience with domain decomposition libraries such as METIS for partitioning large computational domains
  • Experience with documenting software APIs and architecture
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for cross-platform native code (Windows and Linux)

Personal Qualifications

  • Ability to work individually as well as in a team
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English

We offer

  • An international work environment, with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues
  • Flexible working conditions
  • The opportunity to make a difference for water environments around the world through the products and projects that DHI delivers every year

Office location

Hørsholm, Denmark

Valid Danish work permit required – Visa sponsorship not available.

If you require any further information, please feel free to contact Jesper Grooss who is leading the Product team that you would work in (jgr@dhigroup.com). The recruiting line manager is Lasse Kelman Christensen (lac@dhigroup.com).

Position type: Full time

Job type: Software development and IT

DHI are the first people you should call when you have a tough challenge to solve in a water environment – be it a river, a reservoir, an ocean, a coastline, within a city or a factory.

Our knowledge of water environments is second-to-none. It represents 50 years of dedicated research and real-life experience from more than 140 countries. We strive to make this knowledge globally accessible to clients and partners by channelling it through our local teams and unique software.

Our world is water. So whether you need to save water, share it fairly, improve its quality, quantify its impact or manage its flow, we can help. Our knowledge, combined with our team's expertise and the power of our technology, holds the key to unlocking the right solution.

For more information please visit www.dhigroup.com

title: Talent Management Specialist
description:
The Talent Management Specialist is responsible for the administration, execution, and continuous improvement of the company’s performance management program. This role partners closely with HRBPs, managers, and employees to ensure performance review processes are effectively implemented and provide guidance and support throughout the performance cycle. This role also partners with HRBPs and managers to identify and develop training programs to support manager/leadership and employee development.

The Talent Management Specialist serves as a subject matter resource for performance management and training, helping to create consistent, engaging, and effective talent practices across the organization. The role also supports the ongoing development of talent management processes, tools, and resources to enhance employee performance, development, and engagement.

Responsibilities

Performance Management
• Manage the company’s mid-year and annual performance review process, including planning, timelines, system administration, communications, and follow-up.
• Coordinate goal-setting, mid-year and year-end review activities, ensuring processes are completed accurately and on schedule.
• Partner with HR and managers to provide guidance on performance management practices, goal setting, performance evaluations, and effective feedback.
• Develop and maintain manager and employee resources, tools, and communications to support the performance management process.
• Monitor completion of performance management activities and proactively follow up with managers and employees as needed.
• Support managers in understanding and effectively applying performance management processes and expectations.
• Identify opportunities to improve the performance review process based on feedback, organizational needs, and best practices.
• Support the development and implementation of the company’s competency framework and integration of competencies into performance management.
• Maintain performance management processes and workflows within the HRIS.
• Prepare reports and analyze performance management data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Training & Development
• Assist HR Director in coordinating and administering company-wide training programs, including planning, scheduling, communications, registration, attendance tracking, and follow-up.
• Partner with HR and business leaders to identify training needs and recommend appropriate learning solutions.
• Evaluate training effectiveness through participation, feedback, and other appropriate measures.
• Support the development and implementation of leadership and manager training programs.
• Identify opportunities to improve the employee learning experience and expand the organization’s training offerings.

Skills & Experience Requirements

Skills & Experience Requirements
• 5 years of experience in human resources, talent management, learning and development, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience administering performance management programs.
• Experience with competency frameworks and integrating competencies into performance management is a plus.
• Experience coordinating or managing employee training programs.
• Experience with performance management and talent management modules within an HRIS.
• Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage confidential information appropriately.
• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to effectively work with employees and managers at all levels.
• Ability to independently manage programs while collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners.

Education Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
description:
At NORNORM, we’re digital pioneers redefining the workspace industry through a circular business model that’s better for people, business and the planet.

As we scale, strong internal systems, data infrastructure and business insights are critical to how we operate across products, logistics, refurbishment, inventory and customer operations.

We are now looking for a Junior Full-Stack Developer to strengthen our Digital Development team and help build internal digital products, analytics capabilities and operational tools.

This is a junior role, but not an entry‑level trainee position. We are looking for someone with 1–2 years of hands‑on professional experience within software development, analytics engineering, backend development or similar, who is ready to contribute from early on while continuing to learn from more experienced developers.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Analytics backend and data platform
    • Maintain, improve, test and document dbt models and data transformations.
    • Support data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform, including BigQuery and SQL‑based analytics logic.
    • Debug data quality issues and identify root causes across data models and pipelines.
    • Improve reliability, maintainability and transparency of data models, definitions and business rules.
  • BI platform development
    • Support the continued development of NORNORM’s BI tool
    • Contribute to backend logic, APIs, and data structures supporting BI use cases
    • Work with stakeholders to understand reporting and insight needs, and translate these into technical tasks together with the team
  • Full‑stack development
    • Build and maintain new and existing backend services and APIs in collaboration with the development team
    • Support frontend work when needed
    • Learn and contribute to the broader NORNORM technology stack, following testing and documentation practices
    • Take part in communication with users, receive and take action on bug reports, feature requests, etc.

We Imagine That You Have

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree within software engineering, computer science, IT or a related field.
  • 1–2 years of relevant experience within software development, analytics engineering, backend development or similar.
  • Strong foundation in SQL and experience with Python.
  • Experience with software development, including Git/GitHub and writing clear, maintainable code.
  • Understanding of data modelling, data pipelines, APIs and backend development concepts.
  • Able to use AI‑supported coding tools responsibly by reviewing and validating output before applying it.
  • Interest in growing into full‑stack web development beyond the initial analytics/backend focus.
  • and believe that you are:
  • Curious, fast‑learning and comfortable learning from more experienced developers.
  • Detail‑oriented, especially when working with data logic and quality.
  • Pragmatic, structured and solution‑oriented.
  • Able to communicate technical topics in a simple and understandable way.

Why join NORNORM?

If you join NORNORM, you become part of a company where technology is central to enabling and scaling a circular business model across products, logistics, refurbishment and customer operations.

You’ll get the opportunity to work on systems and digital products that play an important role in how NORNORM operates and scales as a circular business. You’ll help shape how internal tools, analytics capabilities and digital products evolve across the organisation while working closely with experienced full‑stack developers and gradually taking on more ownership over time.

We offer a collaborative, high‑trust environment with short decision paths, strong learning opportunities and a culture shaped by curiosity, courage and a shared ambition to help build a more circular future.

Practicalities

  • This role is office‑first hybrid‑remote: We value both flexibility and collaboration, and our rule of thumb is simple: more on‑site than off‑site.
  • Please note that we unfortunately do not offer relocation support or visa sponsorship. An existing permission to work in Denmark is therefore a mandatory requirement.

Please note that due to summer holiday, we won’t start screening applications until August.

  • Mentoring and coaching fellow engineers, reviewing code and helping raise engineering standards across the team.

Your Benefits

  • Engage with an expert, collaborative team committed to innovation and excellence.
  • Access comprehensive professional growth opportunities, including specialised training programmes and international exposure.

title: Integrated Master Scheduler

Title:

Integrated Master Scheduler

Job Summary

The Integrated Master Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing complex Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) that support critical program objectives across multiple project phases. This position serves as a key member of the program team, ensuring schedule integration, alignment, and visibility for program leadership and customer stakeholders. The role evaluates program performance through schedule analysis, identifies potential risks to execution, and develops actionable mitigation strategies to support successful outcomes. Working across engineering, program management, operations, and customer organizations, the Integrated Master Scheduler provides accurate and timely schedule reporting that enables informed decision-making. Success in this position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate complex activities while maintaining compliance with customer and contractual scheduling requirements.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and update the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) to support program execution, planning, and reporting requirements.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate schedule risks impacting critical path activities, milestones, deliverables, and program objectives.
  • Perform schedule variance analysis and develop recovery plans and mitigation strategies to address delays and execution challenges.
  • Apply advanced scheduling methodologies and best practices to optimize workflow efficiency and maintain schedule integrity across multiple project phases.
  • Coordinate with program management, engineering, operations, subcontractors, and customer stakeholders to ensure schedule alignment and integration.
  • Maintain standardized IMS structures and schedule documentation in accordance with government-approved formats and contractual requirements.
  • Prepare monthly and ad hoc schedule updates, status reports, metrics, and leadership briefings to support strategic decision-making.
  • Track key dependencies, milestones, and program performance indicators to ensure visibility into schedule health and execution status.
  • Other duties as assigned in support of mission and business requirements.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • 10 years of experience in program scheduling, project controls, planning, or Integrated Master Scheduling.
  • Active Secret Clearance
  • Experience developing and maintaining Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) for complex programs or projects.
  • Experience performing critical path analysis, schedule variance analysis, and schedule risk assessments.
  • Experience preparing schedule status reports and supporting program reviews for management or government customers.
  • Experience coordinating schedule activities across multiple functional organizations and project stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. government, aerospace, defense, or large-scale engineering programs.
  • Experience with Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project scheduling tools.
  • Knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and program control processes.
  • Experience supporting schedule compliance reviews, audits, or DCMA scheduling requirements.
  • Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.

Day Shift; 5-6 days per week depending on need

Location:

Remote Alabama, Remote Florida, Remote Georgia, Remote Louisiana, Remote Mississippi, Remote North Carolina, Remote South Carolina, Remote Tennessee, Remote Texas

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Position Overview:
The Clinical Documentation Specialist improves the overall quality and completeness of clinical documentation; facilitates modifications to clinical documentation through extensive interaction with physicians, nursing staff, other patient caregivers, and coding staff to ensure that documentation reflects the complexity and severity of illness for a complete and accurate level of service rendered to patients. He/She analyzes the clinical status of patients, current treatment plans and past medical history to identify potential gaps in clinical documentation. The Clinical Documentation Specialist educates and serves as a clinical liaison to nursing staff and other clinicians on compliant documentation and accurate coding. He/She reconciles DRG differences between the Coding staff and Clinical Documentation Specialist; and monitors activities to ensure that all clinical documentation is in compliance with State and Federal payer regulations.

DISCLAIMER: This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, efforts, requirements or working conditions associated with the job. While this intends to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks performed as assigned.

Education:
High School graduate or equivalent required.

If Registered Nurse, must be a graduate from NLN School of Nursing; Bachelor of Science in Nursing required.

License:
If Registered Nurse (RN), must hold current applicable license to practice in Mississippi. Current Mississippi RN license preferred.

Certifications:
If not a Registered Nurse, must be certified by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) or American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC) as a:
• Registered Health Information Administrator
• Registered Health Information Technician

• Certified Code Specialist

• Certified Inpatient Coder

Must complete all requirements (including continuing education) to maintain certification.

CCDS preferred.

Must have de-escalation training completed by the end of position orientation (90 days); must have appropriate level of de-escalation training.

Experience:
A Registered Nurse must have a minimum of two (2) years’ nursing experience in an acute-care facility.

Coders must have a minimum of two (2) years’ experience in ICD-9 CM and experience utilizing ICD-10 CM and ICD-10 PCS in an inpatient setting. Must have working knowledge of the AHA Coding Clinic.

An understanding of the MS-DRG payment system is required. An understanding of APR-DRG’s preferred.

Reports to:

Clinical Documentation Manager

Supervises:

None

Physical Demands:
Work is moderately active: involves sitting with frequent requirements to move about the office, move about the facility, and to travel to another facility within the SRHS service area. Work involves exerting a negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body.

Work involves using many physical motions in performing daily work activities; subject to exposure of body fluids, sputum and tissues, which may carry the hazard of infectious disease. Work involves using repetitive motions: substantial movements of the wrists, hands, and or fingers while operating standard office equipment such as computer keyboard.

Work involves being able to perceive the nature of sound at normal speaking levels with or without correction; the ability to make fine discriminations in sound. Work requires close visual and acuity and the ability to adjust the eye to bring an object into sharp focus, i.e. shift gaze from viewing a computer monitor to forms/printed material that are closer to compare data at close vision.

Must be able to be active for extended periods of time without experiencing undue fatigue. Must be able to work schedules assigned with the understanding that changes may be instituted according to the needs of the hospital for off days, shifts or weekends.

Mental Demands:
Must demonstrate keen mental faculties/assessment and decision making abilities. Must demonstrate superior communication/speaking/enunciation skills to receive and give information in person and by telephone. Must demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills. Must possess emotional stability conducive to dealing with high stress levels. Must demonstrate ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Attention to detail and the ability to multi-task in complex situations is required. Must have the ability to maintain collaborative and respectable working relationships throughout SRHS and other organizations.

Special Demands:
Must possess superior customer service skills and professional etiquette. Must possess proficient knowledge and ability to use a computer (must be keyboard proficient) and other office technology (i.e., telephone, fax, etc.), MS Outlook and Word.

Job requires traveling throughout the SRHS service area – with the employee providing his/her own transportation.

Work requires the ability to function independently, adapt to workload demands, set priorities, and understand and set goals. Must possess highly developed organizational, planning and management writing skills. Must understand the fundamentals of automated data processing, and be able to quickly gain a detailed understanding of complex computerized and non-computerized information.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
At Side, we work alongside some of the world's leading game developers to solve complex technical challenges and bring exceptional player experiences to life. As our projects continue to grow in scale and technical ambition, we're looking for a Senior Engine & Graphics Engineer with deep expertise in Unreal Engine 5, rendering systems, and performance optimisation.

This is a highly senior, hands-on engineering role suited to someone who enjoys getting close to the hardware, diagnosing difficult performance problems, and building elegant technical solutions. You'll work across engine, rendering, and graphics systems, helping teams maximise visual fidelity while ensuring games run efficiently across target platforms.

We're looking for an engineer who thrives on autonomy, takes ownership of complex challenges, and proactively drives improvements without needing constant direction. You'll be trusted to identify issues, propose solutions, and work closely with project leadership, clients, and development teams to deliver meaningful technical impact across multiple projects.

Requirements

What you will be doing:

  • Lead the development and optimisation of core engine, rendering, and graphics systems within Unreal Engine 5, helping teams achieve high levels of visual quality and performance.
  • Profile, analyse, and resolve complex CPU, GPU, memory, and platform-specific performance challenges across active development projects.
  • Partner closely with gameplay engineers, technical artists, and content teams to identify bottlenecks and implement scalable technical solutions.
  • Own performance and optimisation strategy, establishing best practices and providing technical direction across multiple projects.
  • Contribute hands-on to engine-level development, rendering pipelines, graphics features, and low-level systems programming.
  • Serve as a senior technical advisor to internal teams and clients, communicating risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly.
  • Proactively identify technical challenges before they become production issues and drive solutions with minimal oversight.
  • Mentor engineers and champion engineering excellence through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical leadership.

What We're Looking For:

  • Significant professional experience as a Senior, Lead, or Principal, with deep expertise in game engine and graphics programming.
  • Expert knowledge of Unreal Engine 5, including engine architecture, rendering systems, performance profiling, and optimisation techniques.
  • Strong understanding of graphics programming fundamentals, GPU performance, rendering pipelines, shaders, and modern graphics APIs.
  • Experience optimising games or real-time applications across PC, console, or other hardware platforms, with a solid understanding of hardware-level performance constraints.
  • Excellent C++ programming skills and experience working with low-level engine systems.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously, take ownership of complex technical challenges, and proactively deliver solutions while keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and technical leadership.
  • Passion for solving difficult engineering problems and improving performance, scalability, and overall technical quality.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Dynamic, multicultural and fun environment.
  • You will be working for the world's leading provider of game services.
  • We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.

About Side

Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30+ years' experience from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with 20 studios in 14 countries across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets.

Help us bring stories to the world! Join a global team of passionate gamers and contribute to delivering unforgettable game experiences.
